70000316.name: Little Tower of Babel
70000316.description: Another painting of the Tower of Babel by Pieter Brueghel (father). Unlike the larger piece, the construction is not depicted. For some reason, the artist chose to paint with a strong red paint, which evokes the idea of the imminence of God's wrath.

70000317.name: The Pieta
70000317.description: A marble statue by Michelangelo. An image of the Virgin Mary embracing the executed body of Jesus. This vivid depiction of the human form and the pleats in the clothes make it hard to believe that this is cold stone. Mary appears to be young compared to Jesus, but this is simply one form of expression.

70000318.name: Madonna & Goldfinch
70000318.description: A painting by Raphael. It is called this to distinguish it from other similarly named paintings. The name comes from the young Saint John, pictured on the left, holding a goldfinch. It's real name is Madonna del Cardellino.

70000319.name: Boat Shaped Bowl
70000319.description: A decorated gold and enamel cup carved from a beautiful piece of lapis lazuli. The stone was carved in Italy, but the metallic sections appear to have been adjusted many times over the years.

70000320.name: The Primavera
70000320.description: A painting by Botticelli. Depicting Venus and Cupid in the centre, the Goddess Flore blown by Zephyros on the right, and the three goddesses of beauty, chastity, and love with Mercury on the left.

70000321.name: Adoration of the Magi
70000321.description: An uncompleted painting by Leonard Da Vinci. Thought to be his first large project, but left unfinished as he moved to another country while painting. The subject of the painting is the three wise men visiting the new born Jesus to offer their worship and service.

70000322.name: The Maximilian Hunting Scenes
70000322.description: The original painting is by Bernard van Orley. The tapestry shows a hunting scene lead by Maximilian I, the Holy Roman Emperor. This piece is known as September and is the seventh in a series of 12. A huge piece of work at 4.5m in length and 5.5m in width.

70000323.name: Mary Magdalene
70000323.description: A wooden statue by Donatello. Mary Magdalene converted and became a follower of Jesus. After his death she is thought to have shut herself away in the mountains as the world had nothing left to offer her. Normal statues depict her as young and beautiful, while here she is shown as an elderly woman.

70000324.name: Moses
70000324.description: A marble statue by Michelangelo. One of the statues created for the grave of Julius II. He holds the slate bearing the Ten Commandments, and gazes into the distance with a tense expression.

70000325.name: Mona Lisa
70000325.description: A painting by Leonard Da Vinci. The mysterious smile, the elegant texture of the clothes, the aerial perspective of the background, and above all we can envision the blood flowing beneath the skin. This is surely a perfect portrait.

70000326.name: Portrait of Pierre Quthe
70000326.description: A portrait by Francois Clouet. The model is his friend Pierre Quthe. He was influenced by Italy and Flandres, and this is an example of a natural and very realistic painting.

70000327.name: The Lacemaker
70000327.description: A painting by Johannes Vermeer. A small painting at only 24cm in length, but the woman, ardently knitting her lace, is beautifully drawn. The precision used to draw the hands, while the rest of the painting is indistinct, gives it an air of tension.

70000328.name: The Alabaster Vase
70000328.description: A vase carved from alabaster. The transparent alabaster gives it a unique beauty.

70000329.name: The Yellow Diamond
70000329.description: A yellow diamond. As the transparency of the diamond increases, so too does the value.

70000330.name: The Relief Vase
70000330.description: A jar decorated with a beautiful relief. This is probably for decoration only and not for use.

70000331.name: The Eternal Star
70000331.description: A huge diamond well over 100 carats. Normally larger diamonds are coloured, but this one is completely clear. With so few inclusions, you could consider this diamond something of a miracle.

70000332.name: The Angel Heart
70000332.description: A huge ruby of more than 100 carats. Since a ruby with more than 1 carat is extremely rare, a ruby of this side is incredibly valuable. Also, its captivating colour has earned it the name Angel's heart.

70000333.name: The Queen's Necklace
70000333.description: A necklace thought to be the property of a queen. The power of the Royal family is symbolized by the huge ruby, the large sapphire, and the ample diamond studs.

70000334.name: Gold Armour
70000334.description: A suit of armour over which the bare metal has been decorated with gold. Since gold is not known for its strength, it is reasonable to assume that this was only used for decoration or festivals.

maps.name: Goldwork Armour Map
maps.prerequisite: Shield of the Knights of St. John

70000335.name: Silver Armour
70000335.description: A suit of armour over which the bare metal has been decorated with silver. Although silver is not a strong metal, it is believed that it contains the power to repel evil, so it was likely used for festivals.

70000336.name: Gold Patterned Pitcher
70000336.description: A gorgeous pitcher decorated in gold. Although it is ornately decorated, it also has a practical use. This may be in daily use in the house of a noble.

70000337.name: Tapestry with Gold Threads
70000337.description: A gorgeous piece of cloth to hang on the wall. The gold thread gives it a fine texture, and it looks very much like a painting.

70000338.name: Amulet with Gold Inlay
70000338.description: A large charm with golden incrustations. With its precise sculpting, it is valuable as a religious artifact as well as a work of art.

maps.name: Opulent Jewellery Map
maps.location: Africa North Coast South Mediterranean Sea

maps.name: Opulent Jewellery Map
maps.location: Africa North Coast South Mediterranean Sea

70000339.name: Clock with Gold and Sapphire
70000339.description: A mechanical clock with beautiful gold and sapphire work. It can sit in the palm of your hand, and there is a small doll that dances to indicate the time.

70000340.name: Golden Arabesque Lamp
70000340.description: A golden Arabian style lamp. Covered in beautiful arabesque, the metal of the lamp is 18-carat gold. With traces of heavy-use, it is clear that it is an item in daily use.

70000341.name: Small Box of Malachite
70000341.description: A beautiful, jewelled, little box made in an atelier in Hamburg. A real treasure created by a craftsman specifically for his daughter's benefactor.

70000342.name: Peacock Brooch
70000342.description: A piece of jewelry abundantly decorated with jewels such as pearls around a huge opal that shines with the colour's of the rainbow. It seems the craftsman created this to be even more flamboyant than a real peacock.

quests.name: With a heart full of memories

70000343.name: Gentlewoman's Dress
70000343.description: Gorgeous clothes that use an abundance of silk and jewels. With exquisite stitching, this is likely worn by a noble woman.

70000344.name: Cornflower Blue
70000344.description: A superlative sapphire. Known as cornflower due to its vivid blue colour, it can only be found in a specific areas.

70000345.name: Broken Brooch
70000345.description: A broken brooch. Some of the jewels have fallen off, and the clasp is broken. Before it broke, it must have been a sight to behold.

70000346.name: Short Sword for Rituals
70000346.description: A ritualistic dagger. Decorated with gorgeous jewels and gold, it appears to have limited practical use.

70000347.name: Hidden Treasure
70000347.description: A box full of precious metals, jewels, and other treasure. Did some aristocrat or rich family hide this away during a time of war?

70000348.name: Rusty Treasured Sword
70000348.description: A fancy sword with a rusted blade. Decorated with jewels and gold. Since the blade is not that good, it was likely used for decoration only.

70000349.name: Queen's Brooch
70000349.description: A brooch said to have belonged to a queen. A rare purple sapphire is set in the centre. The sapphire is surrounded by diamonds and rubies that bring out its beauty.

70000350.name: Silver Candlestick
70000350.description: Silver in known for it's white shine, but this candlestick has an even greater glow than normal. There is a secret in the type and ratio of the metal mixed with the silver, but it is a fiercely guarded secret.

70000351.name: Sultan's Costume
70000351.description: The Sultan has ultimate authority over the Islamic movement. These clothes were worn by an early Sultan. Made from a generous amount of silk from China as well as expensive dyes.

70000352.name: Sultan's Diadem
70000352.description: A crown owned by the Sultan who governed the Islamic movement. Normally, the Sultan doesn't wear a crown, so this may have been tribute from another someplace else.

70000353.name: Ironside's Crown
70000353.description: In the past, the Navarra kingdom in the north of the Iberian Peninsula was the most prosperous region of Iberia. This is thought to be the first crown of the royal family. Although old, it was made with delicate and elaborate craftsmanship.

70000354.name: The Siren's Harp
70000354.description: A harp, said to be that of a siren, one of the monsters who lured sailors to their deaths with irresistible music. Decorated with gold and jewels, it is uncertain if it truly belonged to a Siren or not.

70000355.name: Inlayed Armour
70000355.description: This armour is inlayed with gold and silver work. It seems likely that this was created for festivals and purely decorative purposes.

70000356.name: Ivory Statue of Goddess
70000356.description: A statue of a goddess carved from ivory. An unbelievably detailed piece of work.

70000357.name: The Queen's Soul
70000357.description: A huge emerald of more than 1000 carats. Normally an emerald of this size would have a lot of cracks and inclusions, but remarkably this stone has none giving it a wondrous clarity. The name supposedly comes from Cleopatra because of her love for emeralds.

70000358.name: The Turquoise Amulet
70000358.description: A charm with a huge turquoise set in the center. Turquoise is used as a charm by many civilizations.

70000359.name: Marble Statue of a Woman
70000359.description: A marble statue of a woman. It has beautiful, rounded lines and does not appear to be that old.

70000360.name: Marble Statue of a Man
70000360.description: A marble statue of a man. Here we can see the Greek style being emulated, and the physical beauty is wonderfully expressed.

70000361.name: Marble Table
70000361.description: A gorgeous marble table, beautifully decorated. Without considerable financial wealth, one can't acquire furnishings such as these.

70000362.name: Sculptured Marble Tiles
70000362.description: A marble tile with a relief. Used to decorate walls and floors.

70000363.name: Dragon's Fangs
70000363.description: Purportedly a dragon's fang. The huge fang has a black sheen and, if this is truly a dragon's, the beast itself must be longer than 100 meters. Although one cannot be sure that this is the real deal, you can gain courage just by looking at it.

70000364.name: Mermaid's Tears
70000364.description: A pearl of only 2 cm in diameter. It has a pure-white and wonderful lustre. With a beauty that clearly sets it apart from other pearls, it is understandable why some believe it to be a mermaid's tear.

70000365.name: The Cursed Ring
70000365.description: A wonderfully crafted ring that enchants all who gaze upon it. However, all of its past owners have suffered a terrible fate. It must carry a powerful curse.

70000366.name: Dynastic Diadem
70000366.description: A splendid jewelled crown, said to bring power to the one who owns it. This legend may have been fabricated however. The wealth of the Hanseatic League was used to create it.

70000367.name: The Ring of the Earl's Daughter
70000367.description: The ring of an Earl's daughter who suffered terrible misfortune. It uses a large, rare, and valuable blue crystal, and a stamp on the inside of the band proves its place of origin.

quests.name: The ring of a particular girl
The ring of a particular girl

70000368.name: The Banshee's Tears
70000368.description: A jewel bearing the name of a fairy Banshee, herald of death in Celtic mythology. Once set in the deadly Gae Bulg spear, it was removed and buried deep below ground for fear that it would bring bad luck.

70000369.name: Peacock Colour
70000369.description: A superb example of a black pearl that shines with the colours of the rainbow. A pearl of this colour, perfectly round, is extremely rare.

70000370.name: Pigeon Blood
70000370.description: A superb example of a ruby. The vivid bright red is thought to resemble the blood of a dove. It is not easy to discover such a large ruby, so this drop of dove's blood carries tremendous value.

70000371.name: Pink Diamond
70000371.description: A pink diamond. The higher the clarity and the better the color, the higher the value.

70000372.name: Blue Diamond
70000372.description: A blue diamond. A beautiful blue diamond is extremely rare and very hard to find.

70000373.name: Blue Flame
70000373.description: A sapphire with a superb, dazzling shine. At a size of almost 1000 carats, mere standard polishing techniques could not improve on it's shine. It has a beautiful, yet bedazzling, blue and is of the highest quality.

70000374.name: Bronze Statue of a Woman
70000374.description: A bronze statue of a woman. Thought to be comparatively recent. A beautiful statue fashioned in the Greek style.

70000375.name: Bronze Statue of a Man
70000375.description: A bronze statue of a man. A statue fashioned with the dignity of the ancient Greek style. It is likely this was crafted recently, and not during the era when that style was common.

70000376.name: Persian Style Vase
70000376.description: A beautiful jar bearing patterns particular to Persia. There are many depictions of plants, since in the Islamic faith, they avoid drawing images of living creatures.

70000377.name: Small Bejewelled Box
70000377.description: A beautiful box decorated with colourful jewels. One wonders if it's the jewellery box of a noble woman.

70000378.name: Necklace Worn Off Plating
70000378.description: A beautifully crafted gilded necklace that is probably not too valuable. The gilding is peeling off, so it's looking pretty bad now.

70000379.name: The Fairy Whispers
70000379.description: A huge opal, well over 2000 carats. It's wonderfully clear, and you can see straight to the sparkle at the centre. Legends say that a fairy lives in this gem, and will grant it's wearer a wish if it likes her.

quests.name: Treasure in which a fairy dwells

70000380.name: Jade
70000380.description: A perfect jade with fantastic clarity. Bright green with no scratches. It is hard to find gems such as these; it clearly has a very high value.

70000381.name: The Bones of a Young Dragon
70000381.description: A huge, almost petrified bone, the likes of which have never before been seen. Something this size could not come from any animals around today. It might be a dragon's bone, but seems a bit small for that. Perhaps a young dragon...?

quests.name: Find the bones of a dragon
Find the bones of a dragon
Find the bones of a dragon
Find the bones of a dragon

70000382.name: The Bones of a Giant Shark
70000382.description: The skeleton of a large shark, easily over 10m. The teeth can clearly be seen, but other than that, there are only traces because shark's bone is soft. More importantly, why were the bones of such a huge shark discovered on land...?

quests.name: That which should not be on land
That which should not be on land
That which should not be on land

70000383.name: Giant Egg Shaped Stone
70000383.description: A strange stone shaped like an egg. It looks so real with its egg-shell. No living thing could lay an egg of this size. Could it be a dragon's egg?

70000384.name: Stone with a Grass Pattern
70000384.description: A stone bearing the pattern of a plant that looks like a fern. Although it seems pretty big for a fern. Why would a leaf become a stone? Is it a fake?

70000385.name: Fossilized Insect Shape of Shoe
70000385.description: A flat stone shaped like an insect. It looks a little like a sea louse, but it's too big. Does anything similar live near here? And why does this stone have such a peculiar design?

70000386.name: Bones of Long Necked Dragon
70000386.description: A bone of a huge animal with a neck the same length as its body. The total length is more than 20m. But it has transformed into stone, although it is shaped like bone. Is there really something out there that looks like this? It has no horns and wings like a dragon, perhaps it is a different creature from legend...

70000387.name: Bones of Dragon with Fin
70000387.description: A stone-like bone of a large animal that has spines on its back. Could this really be out there somewhere? If it is, it must be ferocious like the devil incarnate.

70000388.name: Bones of Hornless Dragon
70000388.description: A stone shaped like the bones of a very large animal. It has four feet, a big body, and a long neck and tail; sounds like the dragon of legend, but there are no horns or wings. Perhaps the appearance of the legendary dragon has been exaggerated and this is the real thing?

70000389.name: The Bones of a Winged Dragon
70000389.description: A bedrock shaped like a dragon with huge wings. It was discovered in the rocky stretches near Alexandria. With its great wings expanded, it is all dragon. This may well be the dragon of legend.

70000390.name: The Bones of a Bird like Lizard
70000390.description: From the head to the body it has the appearance of a lizard, but the arms are like bird's wings. For some reason it appears to be stone. Their is a wing-like pattern around the body, and the entire body appears to have been covered in feathers. I've neither seen nor heard of such an animal. Might it be a new species?

70000391.name: Bones of Lizard with Two Feet
70000391.description: This stone bears the outline of a large lizard's bone. It appears that it stood on two legs. Although smaller than a human, it would be very unwise to attack such a creature. Could this really be out there somewhere?

70000392.name: Bones of Dragon with Two Feet
70000392.description: A huge bone from a creature that was over 10m from nose to tail. It's been petrified. It's head is already the size of a large stone, and there are rows of knife-like-teeth in its mouth. If it could spout fire like in the legends, it could easily wipe out a town.

quests.name: A dragon that swims like a man
A dragon that swims like a man
A dragon that swims like a man
A dragon that swims like a man

70000393.name: Bones Half Dragon Half Fish
70000393.description: The bones of a creature with a long neck like a dragon and fins like a dolphin. The bone has petrified. But why would bone turn to stone...? Was there magic involved?

70000394.name: The Bones of a Finned Dragon
70000394.description: The bones of something like a huge lizard from the head to the body, but with fins for hands and feet like a sea turtle. It's about 2m in length, and has changed into something like stone. With it's fins, you'd expect to find it in the sea or in a lake. So why was it found on land?

70000395.name: The Stone of an Eerie Flower
70000395.description: This stone bears the design of a weird looking plant. Its shape is wavy and lined. I've never seen such an odd flower before, is it really out there growing somewhere?

70000396.name: Bones of Dragon with Long Fore-Legs & Neck
70000396.description: Bones of a large creature of approximately 25m in length and 16m in height. Its main attributes are its long neck and its front legs which are longer than its hind legs.

quests.name: Investigating Bones with Long Legs and a Long Neck

70000397.name: Snail Patterned Stone
70000397.description: A very large stone shaped like a big sea snail. If a shellfish gets too big...does it turn to stone? It was also found on land which is even more mysterious.

70000398.name: Ananas
70000398.description: A plant with long, hard leaves. The thick leaves bear saw-toothed thorns, sprouting out in circles from the centre. There's almost no stalk. The colourful flower blooms like an ear in the centre. There are many different types.

70000399.name: Nepenthes
70000399.description: A plant covered in sacks. The sacs contain liquid which dissolve insects that fall in. Could it be eating the insects? If it was big enough, would it eat us, too?

70000400.name: Carnations
70000400.description: A plant whose flower blooms with many pleats. It has a nice fragrance. It has also been bred for gardening.

70000401.name: Norway Maple
70000401.description: A deciduous tree whose leaves turn red and yellow as winter approaches. With many trees, this can be a beautiful scene. The seeds have small wings allowing them to fly on the wind.

70000402.name: Gypsophila
70000402.description: A plant with many small white flowers when it blooms. It is beautiful simply as it is, but when added to a bouquet, it can look wonderful.

ornaments.name: Gypsophila with White Urn on Table

70000403.name: Daisy
70000403.description: A plant that blooms with thick, small petals all bunched together. If you open it up to look at each petal individually, you will see that each has a stamen and pistil.

70000404.name: Clivia
70000404.description: A perennial plant found in South Africa. Its gorgeous red and orange flowers give it a rare beauty. With shiny leaves arranged in a regular pattern, it is quite interesting to behold. Highly valued for its decorative worth.

ornaments.name: Clivia with White Urn on Table

70000405.name: Epiphyllum Oxypetalum
70000405.description: Normally, you can only see its thick leaves, but at night large, white flowers of up to 20cm bloom. Its transparent pure-white petals are beautiful, and it has a string, sweet fragrance when flowering.

quests.name: Beauty who only appears at night
Beauty who only appears at night
Beauty who only appears at night

70000406.name: Cherry
70000406.description: A deciduous tree that blooms with light pink flowers in spring. The leaves and flowers bloom at the same time, and after the flower, the tree bears an edible fruit.

70000407.name: Cyclamen
70000407.description: A plant with large petals that bloom downward. The flowers can be pink or bright red, and it looks graceful and beautiful.

ornaments.name: Cyclamen with White Urn on Table

70000408.name: Irises
70000408.description: A plant that blooms with gorgeous purple or violet-blue flowers. Particularly good for the garden.

70000409.name: Birch
70000409.description: A deciduous tree with a white trunk. Unseen in warmer climates, it thrives in the cold. Silver birch woods are a beautiful site.

70000410.name: Daffodils
70000410.description: A lovely plant that blooms with yellow and white flowers. The bulbs themselves multiply allowing many to grow at once. Despite its appearance, it carries a powerful poison that can kill if ingested.

70000411.name: Bird of Paradise
70000411.description: A flower that blooms in Africa. The flower springs out to the side and gives the beautiful appearance of a bird's beak and tail feathers. If you can grow it, it will make a popular decoration, but this might be hard as its adapted to Africa.

70000412.name: Snowdrops
70000412.description: Also known as Galanthus. A lovely flower that blooms with white petals. It is thought to herald the coming of spring as it blooms when the snow melts.

ornaments.name: Snowdrops with White Urn on Table

70000413.name: African Violet
70000413.description: A small plant found in the interior of southern Africa. It takes root in between cliff rocks, and has a thick fleshy leaf and flowers. The petal has a peculiar, beautiful lustre. Since there are many different strains, it may be good for breeding.

quests.name: Flower that grows in the deep forest
Flower that grows in the deep forest
Flower that grows in the deep forest
Flower that grows in the deep forest

70000414.name: Tulips
70000414.description: A plant with a pot-like flower that comes in many different colours such as red and yellow. The plants grow from a bulb. It has grown quite popular recently, and has been improved through breeding.

ornaments.name: Tulips with White Urn on Table

70000415.name: Rowan
70000415.description: A hard tree with fibres so dense, that it can be thrown into a furnace 7 times without it being completely burnt. Often used for woodwork. It turns a beautiful colour in the autumn.

70000416.name: Tropical Water Lilies
70000416.description: A pond lily only found in the tropics. It blooms with a multitude of brilliant flowers. It would be nice to take it home as a decoration, but it withers as soon as the temperature drops.

quests.name: Flower that blooms below the equator
Flower that blooms below the equator
Flower that blooms below the equator
Flower that blooms below the equator

70000417.name: Baobab
70000417.description: A deciduous tree found throughout arid areas in Africa. Although not particularly tall, the trunk gets thick easily. Sometimes elephants knock them down during the dry season, as they contain a lot of water.

70000418.name: Lotus
70000418.description: A sacred flower in the Orient. Often depicted as the seat upon which the Gods sit. The, thick, elegant petals form its beauty. It blooms in the early morning, and closes in the afternoon.

70000419.name: Damascus Rose
70000419.description: A type of rose that has been cultivated and bred in Damascus since ancient times. They say it has a particularly delectable fragrance, and it is sought after as one of the ingredients in perfume. Such a high quality rose demands a high trading price.

70000420.name: Common Staghorn Fern
70000420.description: A strange plant that grows from tree trunks in forests. Its leaves branch out like deer's antlers. At first, it was thought to be dying leaves, but it is in fact a different plant.

maps.name: Odd Shaped Plant Map
maps.location: Island of New Guinea South Coast

70000421.name: Flame Tree
70000421.description: A deciduous tree found all over Madagascar island. When it blooms, the tree is covered in red flowers, as if it is engulfed in flames.

70000422.name: Lime Tree
70000422.description: A deciduous tree that grows to great heights. It can be found in many places, but it seems to differ slightly depending on the area. In the West, the leaves are sometimes used as a herb. In India, it is believed that Buddha was enlightened beneath this tree.

70000423.name: Tenochtitlan
70000423.description: The capital of the Aztec empire. Founded on an island in the centre of Lake Texcoco, it's three bridges give the place a breath-taking view. Cortes wrote I can only give you half the tale as it is too large and fine a city.

sources.name: E Coast of Latin America(Cayenne, Pernambuco, Grand Cayman, Willemstad, Trujillo, and Caracas)

70000424.name: Madonna Lily
70000424.description: A plant that blooms with beautiful, cylindrical flowers. It has a powerful fragrance. In Christian festivals, white lilies' are often used. The pollen clings to your clothes and it's difficult to remove.

70000425.name: Poisonous Scorpion
70000425.description: An insect with a poison in a stinger at the tip of its tail. The body resembles a prawn. The poison is extremely powerful and has been known to kill humans. Although it is usually found in deserts, it does have a nasty habit of popping up in unusual places.

70000426.name: African Giant Swallowtail
70000426.description: A very large butterfly found in Africa. Its fluttery flight is often mistaken for a flying bird or bat. The largest can be more than 20cm with their wings expanded. If has a powerful impact when viewed close up.

70000427.name: Firefly
70000427.description: A small insect with a glowing abdomen. They can put on a beautiful show if you see them blinking in the forest. No one really knows why their belly's glow.

70000428.name: Rockhopper Penguin
70000428.description: A penguin with yellow, decorative plumage on their eyes. They live in groups, and move across rocky terrain by jumping. They swim like fish in the water, but look pretty dull on land.

70000429.name: Black Crowned Crane
70000429.description: A crane with beautiful decorative plumage on its head. Usually only seen in Africa. Although this crane looks like a flamingo or heron, the way they stand and how they fly are quite different, indicating their species are not that close.

70000430.name: Peafowl
70000430.description: A large bird, whose males have magnificent tail feathers. Peacocks in captivity give the impression of being related to chickens. The males tail feathers are a sight to behold and all their feathers are wonderfully colourful. The female, though, is quite plain, but still lovely.

70000431.name: African Penguin
70000431.description: A penguin with an unusual design from its head to its throat. It lives in South Africa, and there are countless masses of them.

70000432.name: Macaw
70000432.description: A large, richly coloured parakeet. It stands at over a meter when you include the tail, and is very beautiful indeed. Red is the most common colour, but you will also find blue ones. Just like other parakeets, they're not particularly good flyers.

70000433.name: Turkey
70000433.description: A large bird, the males stand at more than a meter in length. It has particularly unusual features with no feathers on its head, and sagging skin. When it grows agitated, the areas without feathers change colour. Part of the chicken family, it is easy to rear, and good for food.

70000434.name: Ostrich
70000434.description: A large bird standing at 2.5m in height. Compared to its body, the wings are pretty small, it can't fly; but to compensate the legs have developed to such an extent that it can run like a horse. Its kick could kill a human.

70000435.name: Pin-Tailed Whydah
70000435.description: A small bird found in Africa. The males have pretty long tails. However, the tail only lengthens during the breeding season. Males are brightly coloured with white and black feathers and a red beak, but the female is a plain and sober brown. The male flies round and round the female, trying to attract her attention.

quests.name: Small bird only found in Africa
Small bird only found in Africa
Small bird only found in Africa

70000436.name: Dodo
70000436.description: A unique bird that is only found in the Mauritius island. It's considerably larger than a chicken, but its wings are too small to fly. It has thick and sturdy legs, but it can't run fast. It's a well natured and easy going bird since there are no predators on the island.

quests.name: A bird like an over-fat goose
A bird like an over-fat goose
A bird like an over-fat goose
A bird like an over-fat goose

70000437.name: Swan
70000437.description: A large waterfowl known for its long, graceful neck and beautiful white wings. It's a migratory bird and moves every six months. The gray birds that accompany them are their young.

70000438.name: Flamingo
70000438.description: A large bird with a very long neck and long legs. It has beautiful pink wings. They live in groups of tens of thousands; to see them together is quite a spectacular sight. Although it looks like a crane, it has a different beak, indicating a different family.

70000439.name: Pelican
70000439.description: A waterfowl with a large sack under its beak. It's considerably large. Perhaps it uses the sack under its beak to catch fish?

70000440.name: The African Grey Parrot
70000440.description: A plain and sober parakeet that is gray all over, except for the tip of its tail which is red. Although plain looking, it is very intelligent, and they say that it doesn't just mimic what it hears, but can hold a simple conversation if you teach it well. It doesn't seem to fly too well.

70000441.name: Stoat
70000441.description: A small animal that looks like a weasel. In the winter, it sheds its hair and turns white. Carnivorous, it eats rats and small birds.

70000442.name: Chameleon
70000442.description: A lizard about 50cm in length. It can change its colour to match its surroundings. It also changes colour when agitated. It lives in trees and flicks out its tongue like a frog to catch insects. It's distinct toe groupings make clinging to trees easy.

70000443.name: Kangaroo Rat
70000443.description: A rat that can use its overly developed hind legs to jump. For a rat, its pretty big.

70000444.name: Viperidae
70000444.description: A snake with a triangular head and deadly poison. There are many different kinds, and it can be found all over, from the tropics to near the arctic circle. It doesn't lay eggs, but actually gives birth.

70000445.name: Sable
70000445.description: A marten with brown rather than black hair. Its winter plumage is stunning, and its fur, known as sable, is highly prized. Due to over trapping, it hasn't been seen much in recent years...

70000446.name: Golden Hamster
70000446.description: A rat with a reddish brown back, a white belly, and virtually no tail. It moves slowly and lives above ground, but it does dig its own nesting holes. It has very big cheek pouches, allowing it to carry large amount of food and nesting material.

70000447.name: Cobra
70000447.description: A large snake with a powerful poison. One bite and you're done for. Larger specimens can be up to 5m, and if it lifts up its crooked neck, it can stand at the height of a grown man. It can strike a peculiar threatening pose and flare out its head to the sides.

quests.name: Poisonous snake that eats other snakes

70000448.name: Clawed Frog
70000448.description: A frog with an unusual appearance that lives in southern Africa. It has black nails, and tiny, sunken eyes, really quite different from average frogs. During times of intense heat, it buries itself in the earth and hibernates.

70000449.name: Jerboa
70000449.description: A rat with long hind legs allowing it to leap through the air. It has long ears, a short nose, and very large eyes.

70000450.name: Hyrax
70000450.description: An animal with a round body that lives in rocky areas. They dig their own nesting holes and live as a community; however, we don't know much about their ecology as they are extremely timid.

70000451.name: Basilisk
70000451.description: A lizard of about 70cm in length. Its tail accounts for over half of its length, and its well developed hind legs allow it to run on two feet. Its toes, especially the middle toe, are very long, and it can run on the surface of the water.

70000452.name: Hedgehog
70000452.description: A small creature with needles on its back. It has small eyes and a pointy snout, giving it quite a charming face. If you try to catch one, it curls up into a ball and extends its spikes. It moves pretty slowly.

70000453.name: Giant Toad
70000453.description: A large frog. It has a lot of lumps like warts on its body. If it feels threatened, it can shoot a white venom from behind its ears. If this gets on your skin, it can be painful and itchy.

70000454.name: Ferret
70000454.description: Also known as a ferret. Because it has longer hair than ordinary weasels, it can look lovely. However, since it is a weasel, it can release an overpowering stink. It must be clear to the crew that they are not to bring one onboard!

70000455.name: Black Mamba
70000455.description: A snake with a deadly poison found in Africa. It can move incredibly fast, and is believed to be able to catch a running man. It is probably one of the most dangerous things alive today.

70000456.name: North African Salamander
70000456.description: A newt with an orange pattern over a black body. It looks like a flickering flame. A similar newt can also be found in Europe, but that one has yellow spots.

70000457.name: Meerkat
70000457.description: An animal the size of a cat that lives in southern Africa. They live in communal groups in their nests and have the habit of keeping a close watch on their surroundings while standing on their hind legs.

quests.name: A cat that stands on two legs
A cat that stands on two legs

70000458.name: Golden Mole
70000458.description: An animal that digs tunnels and lives beneath the earth. It has small eyes and can't see very well. It has well developed toes on its front feet, allowing it to easily dig up the earth.

70000459.name: Dwarf Flying Squirrel
70000459.description: A kind of small squirrel, that's about 20cm from the head to the tip of the tail. It has a wing membrane between its front feet and hind legs, allowing it to fly from tree to tree. Its big black eyes and long fur gives it a very attractive look.

70000460.name: Poison Dart Frog
70000460.description: A richly coloured frog. Such a variety of colours, I don't know whether it's a different species or merely individual differences. Either way, they are all poisonous. I hear that the ones with particularly powerful poison are used by hunters who dip their arrows in the poison.

70000461.name: Lemming
70000461.description: A type of short and fat rat. It has a black line on its back. Periodically, they appear in immense numbers and travel in groups. At that time, many will perish when they come across rivers, seas, or valleys, as they are unable to prevent themselves from diving in.

70000462.name: Loris
70000462.description: An animal that lives in trees. It is nocturnal, has round eyes, and almost no tail. It's not a monkey or any other kind of animal, and it has a mysterious appearance. Normally it moves very slowly, but when it comes across food it can be surprisingly fast.

70000463.name: Aye-aye
70000463.description: An animal thought only to live on Madagascar island. If you look at its face, its front teeth, and its actions, you would think it was a large squirrel. However, its fingers differ from a squirrels. Perhaps it's a different species.

70000464.name: Seal
70000464.description: An animal that lives in the seas of the world. Since the fat under its skin is very thick, it can endure cold seawater. It dives down into the water to catch fish, and swims at an incredible speed. It doesn't move so well across land.

70000465.name: Sealion
70000465.description: An animal with black body fur that looks like a seal. Since it lives in warmer climes, it has a thinner body than a seal. Could they be closely related?

70000466.name: Badger
70000466.description: A short and plump animal like a Japanese raccoon or a bear. It digs holes and lives in groups, its nests are too big to search.

70000467.name: Eastern Black & White Colobus
70000467.description: A monkey with beautiful black and white hair. Apparently it's completely herbivore, and feasts on tree leaves. There are other monkeys that are similar, but this one has the most beautiful fur.

70000468.name: Arabian Oryx
70000468.description: An animal with long horns like a cow. It lives in desert regions. Not particularly large. It's often seen making holes in the ground to sit in. Could be they use this technique to control their temperature.

70000469.name: Armadillo
70000469.description: An animal whose skin, from head to tail, is like armour. It curls up into a ball if it feels threatened, allowing it to protect its body from the teeth and claws of predators. There are many different sizes and designs, but it's unclear if these are different species or just individual differences.

70000470.name: Green Dragon
70000470.description: A large green reptile that lives in the tropics. Some believe it's dragon's larva, but you'd need to raise them for a long time to prove anything. Although it has a terrifying appearance, it is in fact a herbivore.

70000471.name: Black Buck
70000471.description: An antelope from India. It looks like a cow, but is thinner. It has large, twisted horns.

70000472.name: Impala
70000472.description: An animal like a deer that has long, twisted horns. The horns don't branch out like a deer. It lives in groups and runs by leaping.

70000473.name: Lynx
70000473.description: As large as a mountain cat, it is dappled and has decorative hair at the tip of its ears. It can be seen over a large area.

70000474.name: Okapi
70000474.description: A brown animal that lives in Central Africa. It has a striped design on its feet, it appears to be a relation to the zebra. However, the way it eats and the shape of its head are quite different from a horse, and it may be a completely different animal.

70000475.name: Thomson's Gazelle
70000475.description: A small animal that looks like a deer. It lives in large groups. It has short horns. The entire species is horned, both male and female.

70000476.name: Spider Monkeys
70000476.description: A monkey with a black body, and very long hands, feet, and tail. When it leaps from tree to tree using its hands, feet, and tail it looks like a huge spider. Although its hands look like a humans and are just as dexterous, this monkey doesn't have any thumbs.

70000477.name: Red Deer
70000477.description: An animal found across a large region from temperate to subarctic zones. The male has large horns, while the female is more diminutive.

70000478.name: Zebra
70000478.description: An animal with black and white stripes all over its body. It has the body of a small horse. It is known to live in large groups.

70000479.name: Civet
70000479.description: A cat-like animal with black rings around the eyes, a dappled body, and a mongoose like face. It secrete a musk from the glands near its behind which can be collected and diluted to create an expensive perfume ingredient. Because it's nocturnal and lives in trees it can be difficult to find.

70000480.name: Jackal
70000480.description: A carnivore that looks like a dog or a fox. It's a little bigger than a fox, and there seem to be several different types of body colour.

70000481.name: Machu Picchu
70000481.description: A city in the Inca Empire surrounded by high peaks. In Quechua, it means Aged peak. There is a clear, systematic arrangement of the terraced fields, living quarters, temples, and so on, and we can see the Inca's advanced architectural techniques.

70000482.name: Pangolin
70000482.description: A mammal with scales. It curls itself into a ball if it feels in danger from predators. It has a very long tongue, allowing it to lick up ants. Does it only eat ants?

70000483.name: Chimpanzee
70000483.description: A black monkey that is generally smaller than humans. They live in packs and are very intelligent. There are even a few that can use tools. It is thought they are near relatives to humans.

70000484.name: Aardvark
70000484.description: An animal with an elongated face, long ears, and a short, plump body. It's a bit of a slow mover, but can dig a hole at lightning speed. It has a very long tongue that it uses to eat ants.

70000485.name: Barbary Sheep
70000485.description: An animal that seems to be a cross between a sheep and a goat, and it lives on rocky hills. The groups tend to consist of one male and multiple females.

70000486.name: Hyena
70000486.description: An animal that looks like a dog. It hunts for carcasses that have been left by other carnivores, but it's also a pretty good hunter in its own right. They tend to live in packs.

70000487.name: Hanuman Langur
70000487.description: A monkey with gray body hair and a black face. It's not too big, but the tail is much longer than its body. It only eats vegetables. It's not afraid of humans, maybe because the monkey-faced god Hanuman is a cherished messenger in India.

70000488.name: Fennec Fox
70000488.description: A small fox with very big ears that lives in the desert. It is timid and very quick; if it feels any danger, it's gone in a flash. It hides by quickly digging a hole.

70000489.name: Indian Star Tortoise
70000489.description: A tortoise found mainly in India. It's a herbivore and is particularly fond of red plants, though no one knows why. The radial design of its shell gives it a rare beauty.

quests.name: Turtle that doesn't go into the water
Turtle that doesn't go into the water
Turtle that doesn't go into the water

70000490.name: Bobcat
70000490.description: A kind of mountain cat. It has a striped and spotted design and is not very large. It has characteristic long hair on its cheeks and a short tail.

70000491.name: Artichoke
70000491.description: A type of thistle that produces globular purple flower about 15 cm diameter. It grows 1.4 to 2 meters tall, with jagged leaves. The flower buds have been used for food in Europe since ancient times, and favored as a preventive for hangover and eating disorder.

quests.name: The Suffering of a Large Family

70000492.name: Mongoose
70000492.description: An animal that eats poisonous snakes. It looks like a giant weasel. Not being immune to poison, it will die if bitten. Though small, it can be extremely vicious.

70000493.name: Hamadryas
70000493.description: A monkey that stays in large groups on rocky hills. The males stand out with their long, decorative hair. It has large teeth and is dangerous to approach.

70000494.name: Mandrill
70000494.description: A monkey that stands almost 1m tall. They tend to live in groups of about 20. The males and females look quite different. The male has a very flamboyant looking face. Maybe because of this face and its load roar, it is feared by the locals.

70000495.name: Mouflon
70000495.description: An animal that resembles a sheep. It has horns similar to those of a sheep. It is thought to be the ancestor of the domesticated sheep. It's a very cautious animal and difficult to approach.

70000496.name: Porcupine
70000496.description: An animal with long spines all over its body. Found in Africa, it is usually peaceful, but if it feels any danger, it bristles the spines all over its body and rushes backwards. It has a lot of fleas, and while the spines are painful the fleas can also be a big problem.

70000497.name: African Elephants
70000497.description: An elephant seen throughout the Savanna region of Africa. It may well be the biggest animal in Africa. It is thought that elephants were used to fight in the ancient town of Carthage. I wonder if this one was used?

70000498.name: Wild Boar
70000498.description: An animal with short, sharp fangs and a short, plump body. It's ferocious and has no qualms about attacking humans. It's likely the ancestor of today's pig.

70000499.name: Indian Elephant
70000499.description: An elephant found in India. It weighs in at 5t, and can reach a height of 3m. Because it is peaceful and very strong, the tamed elephant has been employed in transportation and so on. Only the male has large tusks.

70000500.name: Hippopotamus
70000500.description: A large animal that lives on the waterfront. It has a short, plump body, and characteristic short, fat feet. Its head, especially the mouth, is very big. In contrast, the eyes and ears are small; very peculiar features.

quests.name: Massive creature that lurks in rivers
Massive creature that lurks in rivers
Massive creature that lurks in rivers

70000501.name: Giraffe
70000501.description: A tall animal that lives in the Savanna zone of Africa. It has a very long neck and reaches a height of over 5m. It eats leaves from high branches that other animals cannot reach. Its body is covered in a unique pattern and it has two short horns on its head.

70000502.name: Black Panther
70000502.description: A panther with a jet black body. Seems to be the same as a normal panther. Just like other panthers, it can be found living in trees. It's black fur gives it a beautiful, glossy look.

70000503.name: Pygmy Hippopotamus
70000503.description: A small hippopotamus only found in a few regions of West Africa. It looks like a hippopotamus' child, but they are all the same size, so it is likely a different type of hippo altogether. Its body colour is also much darker than a normal hippo. Usually found in forests or marshes, but not often found in water.

70000504.name: Gorilla
70000504.description: An extremely large monkey that lives in the tropical regions of West Africa. It lives in groups and has highly developed muscles. If you observe their behaviour, you will notice they are highly intelligent creatures. Perhaps a close relative...?

70000505.name: Rhinoceros
70000505.description: A large herbivore with a horn on its snout. This animal can grow to up to 4m. Some of them live in groups while others prefer a solitary existence.

70000506.name: Water Buffalo
70000506.description: A cow with huge horns growing out of the right and left of its head. It lives on the waterfront. While some live in small groups, others gather together in larger groups of more than 1000. These larger groups are usually made up of females and their offspring.

70000507.name: Nettle
70000507.description: A perennial plant that grows knee-high. Its diamond-shaped leaves and stems have stinging hairs that can cause painful skin irritation. It is said that nettle tea promotes blood circulation, and cures fatigue and injury.

quests.name: The Vitality of the Large Family

70000508.name: Cheetah
70000508.description: A ferocious animal with a long and slender body. It's body is very flexible, which allows it to sprint faster than even horses. It hunts by silently sneaking up on its prey, and attacking with lightning speed. Though it looks a bit like a leopard, it does not climb trees.

70000509.name: Reindeer
70000509.description: A large deer found in cold climates. The males have huge antlers. Some are even kept as cattle.

70000510.name: Man Eating Tiger
70000510.description: A vicious type of tiger, known to attack humans. Large, even for tigers, they weigh nearly 300kg. Tigers live deep in the forests. However, they discovered how easy it was to catch humans and began to appear near villages...

70000511.name: Nile Crocodile
70000511.description: A crocodile often spotted in the Nile. An incredibly ferocious and dangerous creature, the larger specimens can be over 6m. In ancient Egypt, it was worshipped as a messenger of the Gods. It lies in wait on the river bed, at all times ready to attack its prey.

quests.name: Beast that lives in big rivers
Beast that lives in big rivers
Beast that lives in big rivers

70000512.name: Python
70000512.description: A large snake that can grow up to 10m in length. Although it is not poisonous, it is incredibly powerful and kills its prey by squeezing it to death. It has been known to eat whole pigs. It has little stumps like small feet...if it grew any bigger, would they become feet?

70000513.name: Wildebeest
70000513.description: An animal like a cow that lives throughout Africa. They are known to travel over vast stretches of terrain, and when they migrate many herds join together until their numbers reach the hundreds of thousands.

70000514.name: Brown Bear
70000514.description: A particularly large and dangerous bear. The larger males can grow to over 2m. Extremely powerful, they are much stronger than humans. Since it's omnivorous and hibernates, it can be especially dangerous in the run-up to autumn and in the early spring straight after hibernation.

70000515.name: Dromedary
70000515.description: A camel with one hump. It is domesticated, and used to carry passengers and transport goods and so on. An important animal in desert regions.

70000516.name: Leopard
70000516.description: A large and fierce animal usually seen in areas such as the savannah. With its unique design, it is both beautiful and dangerous. While hunting, it will lay in wait for its prey in a tree. After making a kill, it will drag its prey into a tree to keep it out of reach of scavengers such as hyenas.

70000517.name: Antelope
70000517.description: A large antelope that can get as heavy as 400kg. Its dark orange body has over 10, pure white stripes. Since it lives deep in the forests, and is very timid, we know little of their ecology.

70000518.name: Carob
70000518.description: A 10 m-high flowering evergreen tree of the pea family. Cultivated in temperate regions, it can withstand dry conditions. The fruit contains sugar and has been used as a sweetener since ancient times. It's also known as St John's-bread and is referred to in the Bible.

quests.name: The Happiness of the Large Family

70000519.name: Lion
70000519.description: A large fierce animal renowned as the king of the beasts. The male has a fabulous mane around the face and neck. They live in packs of over 10, but only one male per pack. It is said that the female does all the hunting.

70000520.name: Green Turtle
70000520.description: A green sea turtle that lives in warm sea areas. Its body is brown if it is unexpectedly taken out of the water. Its shell has a diameter of more than a meter.

quests.name: Blue turtle in a blue sea
Blue turtle in a blue sea
Blue turtle in a blue sea
Blue turtle in a blue sea
Blue turtle in a blue sea

70000521.name: Loggerhead Sea Turtle
70000521.description: A large sea turtle that can be found from the tropics to more temperate regions. It has a reddish brown shell. The larger ones can weigh in at over 300kg.

quests.name: Large turtle of a warm sea
Large turtle of a warm sea
Large turtle of a warm sea
Large turtle of a warm sea
Large turtle of a warm sea

70000522.name: Monkfish
70000522.description: A large fish that lives in the ocean's depths. It has a huge, flat mouth, and lures in its prey using a projection that sticks out of the top of its head and dangles down in front of its mouth, very much like a fishing line.

70000523.name: Cone Shell
70000523.description: At first glance it appears to be just a sea snail, but is in fact poisonous. It fires venomous spines into unsuspecting fish that swim to close, killing and eating them. Its sting is fatal to many humans.

70000524.name: Dolphin
70000524.description: A large fish often spotted in warm water. For some reason it can't actually breathe under water. Instead, it breathes through a hole on its back...it may not be a fish after all...

70000525.name: Highly Venomous Sea Snake
70000525.description: A sea snake found in the seas of the tropics. Many have a deadly poison that is highly likely to kill you if bitten. That said, it's a peaceful creature and won't attack unless provoked.

70000526.name: Manta Ray
70000526.description: An enormous ray known as the manta. At over 5m in width, with its graceful, bird-like wings, it's a sight you should see at least once. At first glance, it can appear quite menacing, but it is in no way an aggressive creature; it swims quite peacefully even if someone approaches.

70000527.name: Big Marlin
70000527.description: The swordfish is a large, open sea fish, and this one in particular is exceptionally big. Its sharp, hard snout can sink ships if it swims straight into them, and it's also a very fast swimmer. They're pretty much impossible to catch.

quests.name: Giant fish as large as a ship
Giant fish as large as a ship

70000528.name: Portuguese Man o' War
70000528.description: A jelly fish with a blue, transparent body. Its body floats on the surface of the water, and the tentacles expand to a length of just over 10m around the jelly fish. It has a powerful poison that has been known to kill humans. Even a floating severed tentacle can be quite dangerous.

70000529.name: Clownfish
70000529.description: A fish with white stripes found in warm seas. The poison from a sea anemone doesn't cause this fish any harm. When attacked by a predator, it hides between the sea anemone's tentacles. It is still a mystery why the poison doesn't work.

quests.name: Fish that lives with sea anemones
Fish that lives with sea anemones
Fish that lives with sea anemones

70000530.name: St. Petersburg
70000530.description: St. Petersburg is a Russian port city located on the easternmost edge of the Gulf of Finland of the Baltic Sea. Its name comes from Saint Peter. It is a cultural centre with thriving theater, art, and literature.

70000531.name: Black-Lipped Pearl Oyster
70000531.description: A large clam found in tropical seas. You can harvest black pearls from these. Since pearls are only found in rare instances, it has commanded a high value for many years. Cleopatra is thought to have drunk black pearls dissolved in vinegar.

70000532.name: Striped Catfish Eel
70000532.description: A sea fish similar to a loach or a catfish. Its back is covered in venomous spines. It can cause serious problems if touched carelessly while out fishing. The young fish are more dangerous than the adults as they live in groups.

70000533.name: Hammerhead Sharks
70000533.description: A shark whose head looks like a hammer. Violent by nature, they have been known to attack humans. Because the eyes project to both sides, it has a wider view than other sharks, making it even more dangerous.

quests.name: Investigation of the habitant of sharks
Investigation of the habitant of sharks

70000534.name: Coral
70000534.description: A beautiful creature found throughout tropical seas. At first glance you might think it's a plant, but if you look closer you will see that it's actually made up of many tiny sea anemones. Locals say it grows very quickly.

70000535.name: Coelacanth
70000535.description: A strange fish that seems somehow different from other fish. Differences include scales at the base of its fin, peculiarly shaped tails and fins, and an air bladder full of blubber. My feeling is that this is an incredible creature.

70000536.name: Killer Whale
70000536.description: A member of the whale family that's almost 10m in length. It has a characteristic design and a dorsal fin that stands taller than a man. It can sometimes be seen in large groups. Apparently they are able to call to one another.

70000537.name: Dugong
70000537.description: A large creature that lives in the sea. As opposed to animals such as the seal, it doesn't come ashore. When it comes to the surface to give milk to its young, it has been mistaken for a mermaid.

70000538.name: Blue Whale
70000538.description: A huge whale that can grow up to 30m in length. Its off-white body colour makes it look even bigger. Going by the appearance of its mouth, it strains the water and consumes anything left behind, like krill, shrimp and so on.

70000539.name: Whale Shark
70000539.description: A large shark of more than 15m. It has unusual white dots on its back. Although it's called a shark, it doesn't have any sharp teeth, and swims quite slowly; it's a relatively harmless fish. It's often followed by other fish, and they say that if you spot this shark, you will soon land yourself a big catch.

70000540.name: North Pacific Right Whale
70000540.description: A slow moving whale usually found in warm seas. There are many things, such as barnacles, stuck to its body. For some unknown reason, it doesn't sink after death.

70000541.name: Hawksbill Turtle
70000541.description: A small sea turtle. Its upper beak is curved like that of a hawk. It's said they use the shell for craftwork in the Orient.

70000542.name: Cowrie
70000542.description: A shellfish with a wonderful sheen that was used instead of money in ancient times. It can often be found in warm seas.

70000543.name: Port Royal
70000543.description: A port town located in the central Caribbean. Its location is good, and because many ships were able to dock there, it becomes the base for Buccaneers. Pirates fill its streets; however, it seems order is somehow maintained.

70000544.name: Oriental Butterfly Fish
70000544.description: A beautifully coloured fish found in tropical seas. It has a flat body and pointed mouth. There are many different colours and designs to be found.

70000545.name: Porcupine Fish
70000545.description: This fish puffs itself up and sticks out its needles when it feels any pressing danger. It may be a type of blowfish. Often found in warm seas.

70000546.name: Blue Ringed Octopus
70000546.description: A small octopus that lives in warm seas. Adults grow to about 10cm. When agitated, it turns a beautiful shade of blue. Its mouth contains poisonous glands that can kill with a single bite.

70000547.name: Pelican Eel
70000547.description: An odd looking fish that lives in the deep sea. It has a long, slender body like a snake, and an unbelievably large mouth. The tip of its tail appears to emit a glow.

70000548.name: Xanadu
70000548.description: A city of the southern Mongolian Plateau. Built by the Yuan Dynasty emperors, it was the political capital during the summer months. In The Travels of Marco Polo, it was described as an elegant city with the best technology, and became ingrained in the dreams of many a seafarer.

70000549.name: Triton's Trumpet
70000549.description: A large sea snail that can grow larger than 40cm. In India and the Orient, they use this shell as a whistle. Apparently it emits a deep, booming sound that can be heard far and wide.

70000550.name: Sperm Whale
70000550.description: A large whale that can grow up to 20m. It has an enormous head, crammed with rock hard teeth. I hear tell that sailors have seen it do battle with giant squid, but I've never heard of it attacking a ship.

70000551.name: Manatee
70000551.description: A large, sea dwelling creature that never ventures ashore like seals. It's a slow swimmer and does not appear to be particularly wary of anything around it, probably because it lives on seaweed and swims in waters with few predators. It has been mistaken for a mermaid when it comes to the surface to give milk to its young, and even a monstrous Siren.

70000552.name: Siberian Husky
70000552.description: A large dog that inhabits frozen regions such as Siberia and North American tundra. Its full coat of fur makes it resistant to cold. Intelligent and obedient, with excellent physical strength, they are used by humans for transport and hunting.

70000553.name: Lionfish
70000553.description: A fish with a fan-like fin usually seen in warm seas. The back fin and pectoral fins are exceptionally large. The tips of the fins contain venomous spines, that could kill you if they sting you.

70000554.name: Spiderwort
70000554.description: A perennial native to North America that blooms mainly during the summer. The flowers have three petals, which are blue-tinged violet. The flower word means, a moment of happiness.

70000555.name: Athens
70000555.description: A town with a long history, having existed from the time of the ancient Greeks. On top of the Acropolis stands the Parthenon, which formerly housed a 10m high statue of Athena. Its specialties are olives and high quality marble.

70000556.name: Aden
70000556.description: A historic good harbour at the southern tip of the Arabian Peninsula. It's an important trading point for China, India, Islam, and European nations. In addition to coffee, it produces many types of perfume ingredients like frankincense.

70000557.name: Abidjan
70000557.description: A port on the Ivory Coast . It has grown prosperous due to products from surrounding areas. It handles products such as coconuts, lumber, and ivory.

70000558.name: Amsterdam
70000558.description: A city in the Dutch Republic that has prospered exceptionally through maritime trade. Once under Spanish control, it rebelled against it's tyrannical rule and claimed independence. It has developed various industries, and has been prosperous in spinning and iron manufacturing.

70000559.name: Arguin
70000559.description: A town in West Africa where Prince Henrique the Navigator established a trading firm. It has a prosperous farming industry as well as abundant mineral wealth.

70000560.name: Algiers
70000560.description: A town constructed by the Islamic forces in 980. It was recently occupied by Barbary pirates, and is used as a base. Spinning, mining, and farming have prospered here.

70000561.name: Alexandria
70000561.description: One of many cities called Alexandria established in various countries by Alexander the Great. It has grown prosperous as a trading point between the Mediterranean sea and Arabia. The fertile soil on the banks of the Nile are perfect for farming, and it also handles spices and incense by way of Arabia.

70000562.name: Antwerp
70000562.description: The most prosperous city in the ten southern provinces of the Netherlands. With a prospering maritime trade, it was once the center of Northern European trade. In recent years, that position has been taken by Amsterdam. It handles lace, fine furniture, and oil paintings.

70000563.name: Istanbul
70000563.description: A prosperous city once known as Constantinople, the capital of the Byzantine empire. It was occupied by the Ottoman Turks in 1453 and renamed Istanbul. One of the largest cities in the world. It specializes in luxury items, and also has a prosperous fruit growing industry.

70000564.name: Venice
70000564.description: An extremely prosperous city, the largest trading city in the Mediterranean. Valuable products are handled here. However, this pinnacle of prosperity is now in decline due to pressure from emerging powers.

70000565.name: Oslo
70000565.description: A town built in the mid 11th century by the Viking King Harold. Oslo means God's field in the Nordic Language. Its dairy farms, forestry, and fishing industries are prosperous.

70000566.name: Porto
70000566.description: A port famous for its port wine. Porto means Port, and when Portugal was founded, this area was the center of the land. In addition to its wine, fishing and salt production are also prosperous industries.

70000567.name: Cabo Verde
70000567.description: An island chain west of the West African peninsula of Cap-Vert. Originally uninhabited, it was named after Cap-Vert which means Green cape. It has a hostile natural environment, and its main industry is fishing. Coral can also be harvested from the surrounding seas.

70000568.name: Cairo
70000568.description: Originally a fortress in the Byzantine empire, the Islamic forces built it into a city in the 10th century. Since then, it has prospered as the heartland of the Egyptian region. It distributes distinctive agricultural products as well as cotton.

70000569.name: Kaffa
70000569.description: A town on the north coast of the Black Sea. It has prospered as a trading town through the ages and, in the 13th century, came under Genoan control and used as a base on the coast of the Black Sea. It was recently occupied by the Ottoman Turks. Known for producing Turkish rugs.

70000570.name: Calicut
70000570.description: A large city on the west coast of India. It prospers through trade from China to South India to Arabia, and is a base for many wealthy merchants. It deals in spices, teas, dyes, jewels, and other such commodities, all highly prized in Europe.

70000571.name: Karibib
70000571.description: A town on the west coast of South Africa. A small town whose main industries are farming and fishing, but there are also mines nearby producing copper, zinc, and diamonds.

70000572.name: Calcutta
70000572.description: A town on the mouth of a river facing the Bay of Bengal. An important gateway to Southeast Asia, it also handles goods from China. It trades in expensive textiles, jewels and so on.

70000573.name: Calais
70000573.description: A town in the north of France that faces the Straits of Dover. The cause of many wars between England and France in the past, it has become a heavily fortified town. It produces products such as processed food, ingredients for perfumes, and high quality fabric.

70000574.name: Candia
70000574.description: A town on Crete. Its low latitude means high temperatures. It is believed that the town housed the palace labyrinth of King Minos from Greek mythology. Its olive groves and fishing industry are prosperous, and it also produces high quality dyes.

70000575.name: Cape
70000575.description: A town built near the Cape of Good Hope in southern Africa. It's very dangerous to be caught in a storm in this area. The region is rich in copper and iron mines, as well as producing gold and diamonds.

70000576.name: Goa
70000576.description: A town on the west coast of India. It's trade flourishes, and it handles products such as expensive perfume ingredients, dyes, and jewels. It also produces an abundance of iron ore.

70000577.name: Cochin
70000577.description: A town in south India blessed with calm southern weather, it produces some unique products, In addition to Indian-like dyes and textiles, it produces tropical perfume ingredients, fruit, and jewels.

70000578.name: Copenhagen
70000578.description: A rapidly developing town on the east coast of Zealand in northern Europe. Copenhagen means Merchant's harbour in Danish. A distribution point for farm produce, processed food, as well as amber and luxury furniture.

70000579.name: Salonika
70000579.description: Also known as Thessalonika, this city was the capital of ancient Macedonia. Once a part of the Byzantine empire, it fell under the rule of the Ottoman Turks in the middle of the 15th century. A distribution point for farm produce as well as marble and ingredients for perfume.

70000580.name: Zanzibar
70000580.description: A town on an island off the east coast of Africa. It has prospered as a trading point between Africa, Arabia and India. It is known to produce farm products as well as precious metals and jewels.

70000581.name: Saint-Georges
70000581.description: A town facing the West African Gulf of Guinea. The prospering Oyo Empire and the Kingdom of Dahomey are in this area, and trade flourishes. The town serves as a distribution point for an abundance of resources from inland.

70000582.name: Santiago
70000582.description: A town in the southeast of Cuba. Its geographical features make it ideal for a harbour, and it has prospered as a trading point. A distribution point for a wide variety of unique Caribbean farm produce.

70000583.name: Santo Domingo
70000583.description: A town in the southeast of Hispaniola. Although still developing, it is a useful sea navigation point, and thus has prospered as the center of Caribbean trade. It grows a wide variety of unique Caribbean farm produce including sugar cane.

70000584.name: Sao Tome
70000584.description: A town on Ilha de Sao Tome in the Gulf of Guinea. It grows typical tropical produce such as sugarcane and coconuts. You can also harvest coral from the surrounding seas.

70000585.name: San Juan
70000585.description: A town in the eastern region of the Caribbean Sea. Although relatively new, it has prospered since it acts as a gateway to trade with Europe. It is a distribution point for sugar cane as well as unique Caribbean farm produce and coral.

70000586.name: Genoa
70000586.description: A city whose foundation was laid in ancient Roman times, and which grew to prosperity in the time of the Crusades. It once was engaged in a fierce struggle for power with Venice, but now seems to be on the decline. However, as appropriate for a large city, it does deal in quality products.

70000587.name: Sierra Leone
70000587.description: A town on the west coast of Africa. With high temperatures throughout the year, tropical agriculture has prospered. The town also has a large diamond vein on its outskirts.

70000588.name: Jamaica
70000588.description: A Jamaican town in the south Caribbean Seas. Surrounded by mountains it is ideal for growing high-altitude coffee.

70000589.name: Syracuse
70000589.description: A town in Sicilia. During the age of ancient Greece, it prospered on a par with Athens. After allying itself with Carthage, and being destroyed by Rome, the city has changed rulers repeatedly. Food is its main product, but it also grows some unusual medical herbs.

70000590.name: Suez
70000590.description: A town in the northernmost reaches of the Red Sea. It has prospered through the ages as a gateway for land trade and for pilgrimages to Mecca. It is a major distribution point for produce from Arabia and Egypt.

70000591.name: Stockholm
70000591.description: This city was built by Sweden's Birger Jarl in the middle of the 13th century and is composed of 14 islands connected by bridges. The area is rich with minerals.

70000592.name: Ceylon
70000592.description: A town on an island off the southern tip of India. With a lot of highlands, tea plantations have prospered. It also has rich veins of ore, and produces a wide array of jewels.

70000593.name: Ceuta
70000593.description: A town thought to have been built by the Phoenicians before the birth of Christ. It later fell under Islamic control, and then at the beginning of the 15th century the Portuguese snatched power. It grows herbs such as basil, and coral can be harvested from the surrounding seas.

70000594.name: Seville
70000594.description: A base built by the Phoenicians, it has prospered since the time of ancient Rome. It thrived and developed under Islamic control, and is now a unique town that mixes the cultures of Islam and Europe.

70000595.name: Sofala
70000595.description: A town located in the southeast of East Africa. The center of trade for that area. With its large river, agriculture has prospered. It is also a distribution point for the gold and lumber produced in the mountainous region on its outskirts.

70000596.name: Dublin
70000596.description: The largest city in Ireland. Originally a Viking fort, a castle was later built there. Dublin means black pool. It produces processed pork and whisky, as well as coal and graphite.

70000597.name: Tamatave
70000597.description: A town located on the east of Madagascar. Since the island is so mountainous, there is only a small amount of cultivation. However, it is rich in mining resources, in particular jewel veins.

70000598.name: Tunis
70000598.description: A place where once stood the ancient city of Carthage. The town was built by Islamic forces in the latter half of the 7th century. From there it became the capital of numerous independent dynasties, giving the city a cosmopolitan flavour. It produces farm goods, hemp cloth, and expensive dyes.

70000599.name: Diu
70000599.description: A town in the west of India facing the Arabian Sea. It has existed since ancient times, but fell into ruin and was rebuilt. It has a thriving agriculture, and in addition to distributing crops, it handles commodities such as emeralds and raw silk, as well.

70000600.name: Tripoli
70000600.description: An ancient town that has prospered since before the birth of Christ. It has been called many things throughout it's long existence. During the Crusades, the old town was abandoned and a new one built further inland in order to avoid an attack from the Crusaders. It produces farm goods, textiles and medicine.

70000601.name: Trebizond
70000601.description: A town located on the southern coast of the Black Sea. In the past, it was an independent empire. Its climate makes it ideal for agriculture, cultivation, raising wildlife, and fisheries.

70000602.name: Naples
70000602.description: A historical town built by the ancient Greeks before the birth of Christ. It was once known as Neapolis which means New town. Since it is located in the centre of the Mediterranean, even today it is a large city and an important point in Mediterranean sea trade.

70000603.name: Nantes
70000603.description: A historical town that has existed since Roman times. Its proximity to the Loire river has brought it prosperity through the ages as an important point of traffic and trade. It produces farm products and textiles. Perfume is also an important product.

70000604.name: Basra
70000604.description: A town located near the Persian Gulf. Believed to have been built in the 7th century, it became a center of trade and culture during the 8th century. However, with the decline of the Abbasid Caliphate it began to lose importance. Even so, it remains a distribution point for important products such as Persian rugs.

70000605.name: Havana
70000605.description: A town located on the northwest coast of Cuba in the Caribbean Sea. It is a good natural harbour and a distribution point for unique Caribbean products, including high grade tobacco.

70000606.name: Barcelona
70000606.description: A town that has prospered as a focal point of Mediterranean sea trade since ancient Roman times. It has developed iron manufacturing technology, allowing it to produce cannons and guns. It deals in numerous trade items connected to firearms, but is also renowned for processing leather products.

70000607.name: Palma
70000607.description: A town on the island of Majorca in the Mediterranean sea. With a long history, it has known prosperity since ancient Roman times. A beautiful island enclosed by white sands and a blue sea, it also harbors many unusual plants. It produces an abundance of spices such as thyme, and coral can be harvested from the surrounding sea.

70000608.name: Valencia
70000608.description: A town that has prospered since ancient Roman times. At one point it fell under Islamic control causing an intermingling of Islamic and European culture. A distribution point for an abundance of farm produce, as well as cinnabar produced in a nearby mine.

70000609.name: Hamburg
70000609.description: A city that has prospered as an important trading port in northern Germany. Inland, it is rich with many ore veins, and produces lead, tin, copper, iron, and so on.

70000610.name: Pisa
70000610.description: An old town developed in ancient Roman times. Famous for its Leaning Tower. Pisa was the first of many Italian cities to declare itself a city-state. Its main products are high quality fabrics and marble statues.

70000611.name: Famagusta
70000611.description: A town located in the Eastern Mediterranean on the east coast of Cyprus. Thought to be the stage of Shakespeare's tragedy Othello. It has a warm Mediterranean climate and agriculture has prospered here. There are also copper mines.

70000612.name: Plymouth
70000612.description: A port town in the southwest of England. Located in a strategic location, it has prospered over the years. It mainly produces different types of ore; graphite in particular is an important trade good.

70000613.name: Beirut
70000613.description: A town that has prospered since ancient times. As an inland city port, it is an important town. In particular, Damask and Damascus swords are highly sought after around the world.

70000614.name: Bergen
70000614.description: A town in the southwest of the Scandinavian Peninsula. Though located in a high-latitude area near fjords, it's climate is comparatively warm. It grows cold weather crops, in addition to producing an abundant supply of salt, stone, lumber and so on.

70000615.name: Bordeaux
70000615.description: An ancient town, as proven by the discovery of prehistoric wall paintings. Under English rule for many years, during the Hundred Years' War it was taken by the French. With abundant water, agriculture flourishes in the area. In particular, it produces excellent wine.

70000616.name: Hormuz
70000616.description: A town that faces the Strait of Hormuz in the Persian Gulf. It is an important point for maritime trade, and has prospered since ancient times. Due to its importance, the controlling power changed frequently. An excellent place for rearing livestock, it is also known for distributing high-quality Persian rugs and jewels such as turquoise.

70000617.name: Pondicherry
70000617.description: A town located on the east coast of India. It is a major transit point to Southeast Asia. While spices and fragrance are it's major commodities, it also handles jewels.

70000618.name: Muscat
