70000928.description: The god of maize and bountiful harvest from Aztec mythology. The name means Fingernails pulled out. Sacrifices were required to ensure a good harvest.

70000929.name: The Stone of the Sun
70000929.description: The Aztecs were skilled at astronomy and had a unique calendar. According to this stone tablet, there have been 5 different world transformations and were each destroyed for a different reason. According to the stone tablet, this world will be destroyed in an earthquake.

quests.name: Reason for desire for blood & hearts

70000930.name: The Statue of Xiuhcoatl
70000930.description: The fire serpent god from Aztec mythology. According to the Aztec calendar, it is responsible for carrying the sun up from sunrise to the top of the sky.

70000931.name: The Obsidian Knife
70000931.description: A small knife made from obsidian. It is said to have been used to cut open and pull out the living heart of sacrifice victims for offering to the gods. Although not strong, it is sharp and has a good edge.

70000932.name: Ceremonial Celt
70000932.description: A large celt made from jade. Such a large item was probably not for daily use but instead for ceremonies.

70000933.name: Mirror
70000933.description: A mirror made from a piece of flat polished obsidian. The shamans of Mesoamerica used mirrors to communicate with the god world.

70000934.name: The Statue of Tlaloc
70000934.description: An old god from Mesoamerican mythology who controlled the rain. The world of the afterlife which was controlled by Tlaloc was an eternal paradise to which only the victims of natural disasters, unforeseen accidents, or contagious diseases could go.

70000935.name: Statue of a Jaguar
70000935.description: Jaguars were a symbol of strength in Mesoamerica and were worshipped like gods. Vicious and more powerful than any animal, it was thought to be the highest creature in the world of living things.

quests.name: Statue of a fast and ferocious animal

70000936.name: The Statue of Quetzalpapalotl
70000936.description: This god appears in old Mesoamerican mythology. He was thought to be mythological. Quetzalpapalotl means butterfly covered in feathers. His role in the pantheon was unknown.

70000937.name: Decorated Skull
70000937.description: A beautifully adorned skull found in Mesoamerica. Abundant turquoise is used in the decorations. It seems as if the entire surface was originally covered.

70000938.name: Xipe Totec's Mask
70000938.description: A mask thought to have been used in the cult of Xipe Totec, the god of agriculture. Even in Mesoamerica, in relatively modern times artifacts using metal are found, but none are as intricate and use as much gold as this.

quests.name: The golden mask of the fertility goddess

70000939.name: Jaguar Warrior Mask
70000939.description: The jaguar warrior is a warrior seen in Azteca. Only the most elite and noble could become jaguar warriors. Perhaps this face tells the story of respect for warriors who died honourable deaths.

quests.name: Brave and proud man of the Aztecs

70000940.name: The Statue of Opossum
70000940.description: An opossum is a small marsupial that carries its young in a pouch on its stomach. They were deified in Mesoamerica and many statues were made.

quests.name: Statue of an animal with a pouch

70000941.name: The Mesoamerican Ritual Utensil
70000941.description: A ceremonial earthenware vessel. In Mesoamerican beliefs, prayers and ceremonies are highly honoured and many such ceremonial vessels can be found.

70000942.name: Teotihuacan Tomb Furnishings
70000942.description: A burial item of the Teotihuacan civilization that flourished in the central highlands of Mexico. Because similar burial goods are found in the Mayan and Aztecan regions as well, it is thought that they were greatly influenced by this area in ancient times.

70000943.name: The Mosaic Disk
70000943.description: A mosaic disk made from turquoise. It was made using extremely advanced techniques. Turquoise seems to have been used in ceremonies in Azteca for its sacred colour.

70000944.name: Aurora Drops
70000944.description: A colourful jade circlet. Each piece is large and the craftsmanship is extremely detailed. One look at this finely hued circlet and you know why it is called a droplet of aurora.

70000945.name: Dancing Fire
70000945.description: An opal with an extremely strong shimmering colour. It looks as if it is enveloped in fire. In Azteca, it was sealed off as originating with Xiuhcoatl, the god of evil who controlled fire.

70000946.name: The Crystal Skull
70000946.description: A crystal skull and crossbones. Where and when it was made is a complete mystery. Crystal is a hard mineral and difficult to polish. It would be a shame if this technology has already been lost.

70000947.name: The Staff of Montezuma II
70000947.description: This is the staff that is believed to have been owned by the Aztec emperor, Moctezuma II. While he sought out new avenues for the Aztecs by seeking reforms and strengthening their dominance, he firmly believed the return of the Spaniard Cortes to be that of Quetzalcoatl.

70000948.name: The Gun of Hernan Cortes
70000948.description: This is said to be a gun brought from Spain by Hernan Cortes. He was mistaken for the God Quetzalcoatl and was allowed into the Aztec capital of Tenochtitlan. Thanks to that, he learned that the Aztecs had an extremely well developed military.

70000949.name: The Necklace of La Malinche
70000949.description: La Malinche is the Aztec woman that became Cortes' wife. She was fluent in the Nahuatl and Mayan languages and served as Cortes' interpreter. This has a Western design and is also thought to have been a necklace that was brought by Cortes as a gift.

70000950.name: The Conquest of New Spain
70000950.description: A work by Bernard Dias who campaigned with Cortes' army. It follows his footsteps after Cortes returned home. It appears to have been discarded partway through its creation, and remains incomplete. If it were completed and made public, it would be an important record for future generations.

70000951.name: The Spear of Cuauhtemoc
70000951.description: This is said to be a spear owned by Cuauhtemoc, the nephew of the emperor Moctezuma of the Aztec empire. As a falcon warrior, he was always noble on the battlefield.

70000952.name: The Bible of Aguilar
70000952.description: A Spanish priest that landed in Mesoamerica before Cortes. He was captured by the native people. Upon Cortes arrival, he used the Mayan he had learned to act as Cortes' interpreter. This bible was always kept close by while he was a captive.

70000953.name: Guerrero Costumes
70000953.description: The Spaniard who was shipwrecked along with Aguilar. Though captured in the same way, he decided to live with the natives and even took a Mayan girl to wife. It is said that he refused Cortes's invitation and sided with the natives against the Spaniards. This is said to be the outfit he used in battle.

quests.name: The Spaniard who became a Mayan

70000954.name: Jaguar's Eyes
70000954.description: A coal-black gem that feels as though it is pulling everything into darkness. It is the extremely deep colour of obsidian. The people of Mesoamerica were afraid of it, calling it the jaguar's eye.

70000955.name: Intoxicating Flower Stone
70000955.description: A piece of raw ore from a giant fluorite. You don't get many chances to see one this large. When sunlight shines on it, something inside of it gives off light, and for some reason, the light it gives off is extremely bright. It received its name due to the slightly intoxicated feeling those who saw it felt.

70000956.name: The Earring of Mixtec
70000956.description: Gold earrings worn by the Mixtec people said to have existed in the heart of central America. They had a very high gold processing technology that was as good as any in Europe. I'll bet it was someone from the royal family that could wear something so precious.

70000957.name: Giant Crocodile like Bones
70000957.description: Bones from a giant animal something like a crocodile, well over 10 meters long. It was found in the Amazon. The forest land that stretches out far and wide might have been under water long ago.

70000958.name: Bones of a Long Necked Lizard
70000958.description: Bones from a giant, long-neck lizard. It's over 10 meters long. About the time that this animal was alive, there must have been many other large lizards walking around as well.

70000959.name: Giant Fish Shaped Stone
70000959.description: A stone shaped something like a fish. You can make out what looks like a fin, but it gives an impression that it is somehow different from fish today. I wonder if all fish looked like this during the time of this fish.

70000960.name: Bones of a Giant Clawed Beast
70000960.description: Bones of a large, taloned animal. The shape resembles that of a bear but it's size is much larger than any bear alive today. It makes you wonder how terrifying that animal really was.

70000961.name: The Bones of a Lizard like Bird
70000961.description: Overall its shape resembles that of a lizard, but its head is narrow like a bird's beak. Also, there is no evidence of wings. It appears to be somewhere between a bird and a lizard.

70000962.name: Bones of Spiney Back Dragon
70000962.description: The bones on the back of this creature were split it into two parts. Did the bones project outward or was there skin stretched over it like the sails of a sailing ship? The mystery continues.

70000963.name: Passion Flowers
70000963.description: The flower grows to about 10cm in the shape of a clock. It blooms daily, opening and closing each day.

70000964.name: Ice Blue
70000964.description: A plant with a white bract containing a lot of blue on a cylindrical column; it's beautiful like a work of art. It grows to a height of approximately 1 meter.

70000965.name: Giant Water Lily
70000965.description: A lotus whose giant leaves can be up to 2 meters in diameter, and can float on water. They can even hold the weight of a small child. The flowers change through the day from white to red.

70000966.name: Agave
70000966.description: This plant grows its big, thick leaves to radiate outward, and blooms its flowers on a stem that can grow to several meters. They use its roots to make tequila. That fibre is often used to make rope.

70000967.name: Belladonna Lily
70000967.description: Its vibrant red is truly beautiful. These flowers somehow feel quite elegant.

ornaments.name: Amalias with White Urn on Table

70000968.name: Cattleyas
70000968.description: Flower petals of differing shapes radiate outward from the centre of the dark-coloured tubular flower petals. They are bright, and very beautiful.

ornaments.name: Cattleyas with White Urn on Table

70000969.name: Poinsettias
70000969.description: The red leaves are a type of bract and have small yellow flowers in their center. This plant is known more for its leaves than its flowers.

sources.name: E Coast of Latin America(Cayenne, Pernambuco, Grand Cayman, Willemstad, Trujillo, and Caracas)
E Coast of Latin America(Cayenne, Pernambuco, Grand Cayman, Willemstad, Trujillo, and Caracas)

70000970.name: Marigolds
70000970.description: This blooms with strongly fragrant, yellow flowers. The refreshing flowers are often used as a die.

70000971.name: Dahlias
70000971.description: Yellow, tube-shaped flowers appear in the centre of the petals that have several layers. The larger ones can be over 20 cm tall.

ornaments.name: Dahlias with White Urn on Table

70000972.name: Treehopper
70000972.description: The large, square projections on the top of this insect are hard enough to puncture skin. Ants are known to protect treehopper eggs in exchange for honey.

70000973.name: Plusiotis
70000973.description: The greatest feature is their silvery, brilliant wings that look like gems. It is rare to find a species with such lustre.

70000974.name: Hercules Beetle
70000974.description: This large insect lives over a vast area of tropical forests, and has two, long horns that are the length of its body. Its wings are yellowish brown, and it has black patches.

70000975.name: Tarantula
70000975.description: A giant spider growing red and black hair. To protect itself from predators, the bristly hair over its stomach stands on end.

70000976.name: Neptunus Beetle
70000976.description: A large insect that has two long and two short horns like spears that grow to intersect each other. The surface of its body is a lustrous black.

70000977.name: Rhinoceros Beetle
70000977.description: This insect has upper and lower pairs of long horns, and extremely long front legs. When fighting for food, it uses these long front legs to turn its opponent around and run it off.

70000978.name: Morpho Cypris
70000978.description: It would not be an overstatement to say that the intensely bright wings of this insect are like gems that fly through the air. The white band running from the front to the back wings adds to the brilliance.

70000979.name: Redline Doctor
70000979.description: A beautiful butterfly living in the southern part of the new continent. Its wings have different patterns on the front and back, giving it a truly gem-like beauty.

70000980.name: White Angled-Sulphur
70000980.description: The bright yellowish front wings are truly beautiful. Also, there is one black patch outlined in yellow on each of the white wings.

70000981.name: Queen Cracker
70000981.description: This has light-blue patch patterns over deep and rich blue on its wings. This insect emits a clicking sound when it flies.

70000982.name: Callicore
70000982.description: There is a spiral pattern that looks like a number on the back side of its wings. Its colouring varies with reds and light blues.

70000983.name: Rare
70000983.description: A large bird resembling an ostrich. This particular bird is unable to fly, and lives in the grasslands and brush-lands, and eats leaves and seeds from plant life.

70000984.name: Scarlet Ibis
70000984.description: This bird has a rich red colour along the entire length of its body. It inserts its long beak between water weeds to catch fish and frogs. When evening falls, it returns to its nest made high up in trees by the waterside.

70000985.name: Harpy Eagle
70000985.description: This hawk has a black, fan-shaped crest on its head. It flies at high speed through the tropical forests using its powerful legs and large, sharp claws to catch medium-sized animals, like monkeys, or even large-sized birds.

70000986.name: Caracalla
70000986.description: It has a fine pencil stripe down its chest and back, and an orange head. Most of its day is spent walking on the ground. It eats just about everything including meat, fish, plants and insects.

70000987.name: Sunbittern
70000987.description: A cautious bird living near rivers in tropical forests. When a predator comes near its nest, it spreads out its wings intimidating the predator with the eye patterns displayed on them.

70000988.name: Pheasant-tailed Jacana
70000988.description: A bird with long legs and extremely large feet. With its long toes, it can walk on the leaves that float on the water. It lives in moors and grasslands and eats insects.

70000989.name: Hawk Headed Parrot
70000989.description: A bird that lives in tropical forests. When excited or surprised, this bird raises the feathers over its entire head upward into a fan shape.

70000990.name: Spix's Macaw
70000990.description: This bird has a blue-silver head and a long, narrow tail. It rests its wings at the top of a high tree and flies the same path each day. It eats seeds and tree fruit.

70000991.name: Hyacinth Macaw
70000991.description: This bird has deep blue feathers covering its entire body, and the yellow skin at the base of the eyes and beak are beautiful. It lives at the edge of tropical forests and in palm trees, and eats the fruit of the palm.

quests.name: A sky of the promised colour

70000992.name: Rainbow Macaw
70000992.description: Its head and neck are yellow, but its color changes to orange closer to the chest. Its back is green. Its wings and narrow, pointed tail have various colours. It generally lives in groups of more than a dozen.

70000993.name: Spectacled Owl
70000993.description: Its white feathers around its eyes look like it is wearing glasses. It swoops down from where it is perched on a tree to grab its prey on the ground or hiding under a covering of leaves.

70000994.name: Collared Aracari
70000994.description: One characteristic of this bird is its colourful and long beak. It lives at the edge of the forest and eats in small groups. It also sleeps huddled with others.

70000995.name: Toucan
70000995.description: This bird's large, yellow beak is its most prominent feature. Larger ones can be bigger than 15 cm, and can get food from the tips of branches that cannot support its weight.

70000996.name: Royal Flycatcher
70000996.description: This bird has a brightly coloured crest shaped like a fan. The male crest is red, and the female crest is yellow. The leading ends of both are blue.

70000997.name: King Vulture
70000997.description: With its wings spread, this very large bird can reach a wing span of 1.8 meters. It eats the carcasses of dead animals, but never attacks living animals. It has a brightly-coloured body, and the top of its beak is orange-coloured wattle.

70000998.name: Barn Owl
70000998.description: An owl with a heart-shaped face. It has a wide habitat and has been spotted in forests, grasslands, and the savannah. It knows the precise location and movements of its prey through sound and so can hunt even in the dark.

70000999.name: Red-Crested Cardinal
70000999.description: This bird has a red head, white chest, and its back is covered in grey feathers. It searches the ground for seeds. It lives in open forests near the edge of water.

70001000.name: Opossum
70001000.description: This animal has a pouch in its stomach for raising its young. It looks like a mouse, and hangs in trees using its hairless tail. If it feels danger, it plays dead.

70001001.name: Vampire Bat
70001001.description: This bat consumes blood. It bites sleeping animals and then licks at the blood that flows from the wound. During the day, it hides in caves, and comes out at night to search for food.

quests.name: Shadow that dances in the night

70001002.name: Lion Tamarin
70001002.description: A small monkey of only 25 cm in height. It is covered in gold fur and has a crest like a lion's. It eats fruit, flowers, and insects.

70001003.name: Mata Mata
70001003.description: This turtle has a rough shell and a flat head. It lives at the bottom of rivers and lakes, and with its pointed snout can breathe without having to break the surface of the water.

70001004.name: Red-footed Tortoise
70001004.description: This turtle has red patches on its chest. It prefers humid environments and eats tree leaves and fruit. When it grows, the centre of the shell becomes constricted.

70001005.name: Horned Frog
70001005.description: This frog has horn-shaped projections above its wide mouth and eyes. It buries part of its body to wait for its prey. During mating season, the males will try to find a mate with their cow-like cry.

70001006.name: Paradoxical Frog
70001006.description: Different from other frogs, it has a very long tadpole stage, allowing it to grow to a size that is nearly four times an adult. During its other periods of metamorphosis, its body will shrink.

70001007.name: Axolotl
70001007.description: This animal remains in its larval state without metamorphasing, meaning the adults remain aquatic and gilled in its adult stage. It has a flat tail and large, red gills.

70001008.name: Boa Constrictor
70001008.description: A large snake that inhabits a wide variety of environments, ranging from grasslands to forests. When it stalks birds and large lizards, it first asphyxiates its prey with its fat trunk, then eats them whole.

quests.name: Threat to reaching the New World
Threat to reaching the New World
Threat to reaching the New World
Threat to reaching the New World
Threat to reaching the New World
Threat to reaching the New World

70001009.name: Sloth
70001009.description: A slow moving animal. It stays primarily in the trees, dropping to the ground only for certain functions like defecating. It eats tree leaves, buds, and insects.

70001010.name: Tamandua
70001010.description: This animal uses its long, sticky tongue to catch and eat ants. When it senses danger, it stands up and adopts a threatening posture to frighten its enemies.

70001011.name: Capybara
70001011.description: An animal like a giant rat. It lives in forests near lakes and rivers. It acts in groups to protect itself from enemies.

70001012.name: Bush Dog
70001012.description: This animal has a flat head, small ears, a long trunk and short limbs. Its dumpy body is adorable. It can run backwards at the same speed that it can run forwards. It's good at swimming and diving underwater.

70001013.name: Giant Otter
70001013.description: A large mink that lives in the Amazon river region. It can grow to 1.5 meters long, and eats fish and crabs.

70001014.name: Ocelot
70001014.description: This animal's name comes from a word from that region meaning a wild tiger. It lives in a variety of environments, such as forest lands and dry wastelands. It is particularly good at climbing trees, but it mainly lives on the land. It's not easily found.

70001015.name: Red-eyed Tree Frog
70001015.description: This amphibian has large red eyes, a green body and blue and white pin stripes under its limbs. To hide such a brightly coloured body, it rests by folding its limbs on leaves.

70001016.name: Anaconda
70001016.description: A large snake that lives in the Amazon river region. It grows to a giant length of up to 7 meters. It is active at night and not only stalks animals that come to the water's edge, but has also been known to eat crocodiles.

70001017.name: Caiman
70001017.description: Caiman is a word from the region meaning crocodile. It mainly lives in freshwater. It has a ridge between both eyes, and looks like it is wearing eyeglasses. It skillfully chases down and captures its prey in water.

quests.name: What lurks in the Amazon River?

70001018.name: Giant Ant-eater
70001018.description: Having no teeth, this animal uses its extremely long tongue, and large, sharp claws to eat ants living in ant hills. When it rests, it uses its giant, soft tail to preserve warmth.

70001019.name: Puma
70001019.description: This animal has a firm body, long tail and gold-coloured eyes. It can adapt to various environments; it has an impressive physical ability to catch and eat mice and rabbits.

70001020.name: Amazon River Dolphin
70001020.description: A porpoise that lives in the Amazon river. Its body has patches of pink and grey and it sports a long, hairy snout. It eats crabs and turtles.

70001021.name: Patagonian Sea Lion
70001021.description: A sea creature similar to a large sea lion. Males have hair growing in a crest, and weigh as much as two times that of females.

70001022.name: Tapir
70001022.description: One characteristic of this creature is the crest growing from its head to its shoulders. It is an excellent swimmer and can easily slip away when attacked under water. It eats tree leaves and fruit, and water weeds.

70001023.name: Macaroni Penguin
70001023.description: This creature has a gold crest that really stands out. Its beak is orange, but pink around the edges. It is very aggressive.

70001024.name: Giant Pirarucu
70001024.description: A giant example of one of the pirarucu living in the Amazon river region. It can grow to be over 5 meters.

70001025.name: King Penguin
70001025.description: A large penguin. It can stay underwater for long periods of time, and catches its prey, like fish and squid, deep underwater. Thousands of males and females will gather during the breeding season.

70001026.name: The Gulf of Mexico
70001026.description: A bay located in the deep western area of the waters between the Florida peninsula and the Yucatan peninsula. Hurricanes frequently occur in this area.

quests.name: Investigation of New World's east coast

70001027.name: The Gulf of Honduras
70001027.description: The bay extending to the east of the Yucatan peninsula. It has coral reefs spreading out over a wide area. In the beautiful Caribbean sea, these are particularly wonderful.

70001028.name: The Bay of Campeche
70001028.description: The sea bordered by the Yucatan peninsula and the continent. Known from antiquity as a good, natural port, the people living in the New World and the Spanish have contested over its maritime control for a long time.

70001029.name: The Florida Peninsula
70001029.description: The peninsula located at the entrance to the Caribbean sea and Gulf of Mexico. It has a flat topography and is covered in swamps and bogs. Even now, it looks like it will soon sink completely into the sea.

70001030.name: Cape Catoche
70001030.description: The cape is the northernmost point of the Yucatan peninsula. Europeans following their dream to the New World often became tossed by the merciless storms of the Caribbean and end up on this Cape.

70001031.name: The Co Co River
70001031.description: The river flowing to the peninsula south of the Yucatan peninsula. It is said that when Admiral Colon reached this land, he landed at the mouth of this river.

70001032.name: The Gulf of Darien
70001032.description: A bay of the south Caribbean sea. Admiral Colon visited here, and later the Spanish built a port. It is known as a good, natural harbor.

quests.name: Road to the west coast of the New World

70001033.name: High Priest's Robes
70001033.description: Clerical garments sewn by quilting the cloth of a Buddhist monk of particularly high virtue. Buddhist monks are not allowed to own property; even their garments are not their property. They manage to do with charity from lay people or older monks for their holy garments.

70001034.name: The Lake of Maracaibo
70001034.description: A lake deep in the Venezuelan bay. You can see homes built on pilings at the lake's edge. Recently, the Spanish have built a town on the banks of the lake.

70001035.name: Punta Gallinas
70001035.description: The cape at the leading edge of the peninsula that projects into the west coast of the Venezuelan bay. In recent years, more and more Europeans are settling here.

70001036.name: The Orinoco River
70001036.description: A large river that flows to the northeast coast of South America. Not many investigations have been made, but it is thought to be a rather long river. Near the inlet, it branches into several tributaries.

70001037.name: Marajo Island
70001037.description: An island at the mouth of the Amazon river. It is thought to be giant and bigger than the large Jamaican islands. There are remains of people living on this island from ancient times.

70001038.name: The River Plate
70001038.description: A large river that flows to the southeast coast of South America. Also called the River Plate. The inlet is extremely large, big enough for a battleship to sail in. However, it has a very shallow draft and even normal ships would be unable to navigate it.

70001039.name: Cabo San Antonio
70001039.description: A cape at the south coast of the Rio de la Plata. The coastal area is a wetland area. There is a town called Buenos Aires nearby.

70001040.name: The Gulf of San Matias
70001040.description: A bay at the southeast coast of South America. The sea currents flowing nearby are cold, making this a comparatively cold region. To the north flows a mysterious river whose waters are black.

70001041.name: The Gulf of San Jorge
70001041.description: A semi-circular bay at the southeast coast of South America. The air temperature remains low all year long because of the nearby cold currents and the strong winds blowing from the west. On land spreads an inhospitable, low-temperature region.

70001042.name: Patagonia
70001042.description: Refers to parts of the peninsula positioned in the south of South America. When Magellan landed here, he named the people that lived on this land the Patagons. Hence the name Patagonia.

70001043.name: The Valdes Peninsula
70001043.description: A peninsula projecting into the Atlantic from the south of South America. You can find sea lions on the coast and whales on the South Atlantic side; it is truly a paradise for life.

70001044.name: The Straits of Magellan
70001044.description: A Strait named because from Magellan's attempt to get to the Pacific Ocean. It is extremely narrow, with a complex topography and has become infamous as a dangerous place to sail.

70001045.name: The Sebald Islands
70001045.description: An island found in recent years. It has a cold climate, with few deciduous trees. The shoreline is complex and there are innumerable small islands that dot the area.

quests.name: The island found on no map

70001046.name: Serra do Mar
70001046.description: A mountain range on the east coast in the south of South America. It stands majestically, blocking the winds from the sea.

70001047.name: River Delta
70001047.description: Gravel and mud pushed and flowing downward from upstream pile up near the inlet, making the inlet a shallow area. If the mud is allowed to accumulate over many years, that shallow area may become an island.

quests.name: Island that divides a giant river
Island that divides a giant river

70001048.name: Gulf Stream
70001048.description: The flow of warm ocean currents, such as the Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of Mexico, move eastward pushing through the Caribbean. This is a massive flow of warm currents that stretches all the way to Europe.

70001049.name: Nan Madol
70001049.description: Mysterious buildings found on Pohnpei Island. Giant stones, that could never have been carried by manpower, alone are stacked together to create the castle walls. This cannot be visited unless the tide is out, so it is known as The city of the sea.

70001050.name: Borobudur
70001050.description: Buddhist ruins in approximately the centre of Java. A pyramid shape stacked up on a base platform. Its frighteningly giant scale of reliefs, Buddhist statues, and pagodas are a sight to behold. It is said that inside is a pagoda that holds the remains of Buddha.

70001051.name: Angkor
70001051.description: The remains of cities of the Angkor dynasty. Angkor Wat built by Suryavarman II and Angkor Thom built by Jayavarman IV are famous.

70001052.name: The Ruins of Pagan
70001052.description: A group of temples said to have been built in the Pagan dynasty. Innumerable temples and pagodas were built on a very wide tract of land. They say that they numbered nearly four million, but many were destroyed by the Yuan and now today only some 3,000 still remain.

70001053.name: King Anawrahta's Sword
70001053.description: Anawrahta was the founder of the first dynasty established by the Mranma people, the Pagan dynasty. Even after the creation of this Empire, Anawrahta continued to expand, conquering and absorbing other regions. He brought home Buddhist scriptures from conquered regions and built numerous temples.

70001054.name: The Saddle of Kublai Khan
70001054.description: The horse saddle said to have been used by Kublai Khan, the Yuan Dynasty Emperor. The Mongolians, who were great horsemen, generally used wood saddles, but this was made of tanned leather for long military campaigns.

70001055.name: Narathihapate's Sword
70001055.description: The dagger thought to have been owned by King Narathihapate. King Narathihapate was the last king of the Pagan dynasty. With the country weak from the expense of building vast numbers of temples, the Pagans were attacked by Kublai Khan. King Narathihapate abandoned the Pagans.

70001056.name: The Cup of King Kyanzittha
70001056.description: Heir to Anawrahta, this king of the Pagan dynasty expended great effort in building the Shwezigon pagoda. The Shwezigon pagoda was said to hold relics such as Buddha's bones, hair, and teeth. Might he have celebrated the completion of the Shwezigon pagoda with this cup?

quests.name: He who carried on the ideal

70001057.name: Earrings of Queen Shin Saw Bu
70001057.description: The earrings of Queen Shin Sawbu of the Pegu dynasty. Queen Shin Sawbu repaired the Shwezigon pagoda with an amount of gold leaf equal to her own body weight. These earrings were gorgeous and sparkled as though to display her power, but they were also very delicate and feminine.

70001058.name: The Ancient Rice Paddies
70001058.description: Many rivers with large volumes of water flow along the coast of the Indo-China peninsula, making this a region perfect for growing rice since ancient times. It is not possible to identify the time period, but we might be able to tell when people began living in this region.

70001059.name: Compass of Zheng He's Fleet
70001059.description: Zheng He was an officer that served the Ming. He took long voyages at the command of Emperor Yongle, and travelled toward Africa seven times. At that time, compass technology was still being developed. In China, they used a magnet floating on water.

quests.name: Pioneer of the age of seafaring

70001060.name: Zheng He's Fleet
70001060.description: A figurehead of a Ming dynasty ship from Zheng He's fleet. According to records, Zheng He's ship was a giant treasure ship, and its grand size was said to be incomparable to the ships used by Admiral Colon and Gama. Just looking at the figurehead alone, that may well be true.

70001061.name: The Cursed Keris
70001061.description: The stiletto of Ken Angrok, the progenitor of the Singasari dynasty. He took it from a swordsmith, whom he had attacked and killed. It is said he was killed with a curse from this kris. The blade emits a semi-dull light even now and is frightening enough to make you believe that it has seen its share of blood.

70001062.name: The Sword of Gajah Mada
70001062.description: Gajah Mada was a great leader that served Hayam Wuruk, fourth king of the Majapahit dynasty. Before taking the seat of Prime Minister, he was a soldier. This is said to be the sword he carried when he assisted the second king during his time as a guard.

70001063.name: The Ramkhamhaeng Stele
70001063.description: Inscriptions said to have been written by the Sukho Thai king Ramkhamhaeng. It describes the Sukho Thai period. It is written in a spoken language and therefore easy to read, and so it spread far and wide to reach many people.

70001064.name: The Statue of King Naresuan
70001064.description: The 21st king of the Ayutthaya dynasty. When he was small, he was raised in Burma as a hostage, but when Burma seized Ayutthaya and made Naresuan's father the perfunctory king, he was returned in exchange for his older sister. Later, he strengthened the Ayutthaya army and made efforts for independence.

70001065.name: Patterned Water Jar
70001065.description: There is a lot of earthenware to be found inland on the Indo-China peninsula. Earthenware has been very common since ancient times. This one has a smooth shape and is not only a superior work of art, it is very easy to use as a tool for daily use.

70001066.name: Earthenware Roller
70001066.description: An earthenware tool used for carving designs. It was used for making designs on pottery and for making marks.

70001067.name: Earthenware Stamps
70001067.description: A die made of pottery used for making designs. It seems that a variety of patterns were designed.

70001068.name: The Middle Way
70001068.description: A work by Nagarjuna. It describes the path of Buddhism. Rather than a general treatise of Buddhist faith, it is full of poetry. It has tremendous value as an artistic work.

70001069.name: Prajnaparamita
70001069.description: The name used for much Buddhist scripture. Also called the Perfection of Wisdom. Prajna is a Sanskrit word meaning insight leading to enlightenment.

quests.name: Investigation of the ideals of Java
Investigation of the ideals of Java
Investigation of the ideals of Java
Investigation of the ideals of Java
Investigation of the ideals of Java
Investigation of the ideals of Java

70001070.name: The Flower Adornment Sutra
70001070.description: One of the Buddhist scriptures. It is written about the world of enlightenment seen by Buddha.

70001071.name: The Vimalakirti Sutra
70001071.description: One of the Buddhist scriptures. Much of the content is similar to the Prajnaparamita, but it is composed of stories such as the way to ultimate enlightenment through the conversations between Vilmalakirti and Manjusri.

70001072.name: The Lotus Sutra
70001072.description: One of the Buddhist scriptures. It teaches that everything comes through karma, and it described unique causal relationships with Buddhism itself.

70001073.name: The Phra Buddha Chinnarat
70001073.description: A Buddhist statue created in the Sukho Thai era. The Buddhist statues of this era always featured a full, round-faced image, and a well-rounded body. Even male statues had small waists and were different from the true-to-nature type western images. Legend has it that the God Vishnu lent a hand in creating this one.

quests.name: Beauty to which Vishnu lends a hand

70001075.name: Yajio's Bowl
70001075.description: Yajiro (or Anjiro) is an Asian man said to have led Xavier to Zipang. After leaving Japan, Anjiro visited Xavier at Malacca and urged him to become a missionary in Zipang. This is said to be the bowl taken when Yajiro left Zipang.

quests.name: Man from the land of gold

70001076.name: The Emerald Buddha
70001076.description: A Buddhist sculpture made of jade. It is said to come from a pagoda that was damaged by lightening, but the truth of that is uncertain. It is made entirely of jade, but the way it glitters makes it look like it was made of emeralds. That is why it has come to be called the Emerald Buddha.

quests.name: That which is brought by god of thunder

70001077.name: The Statue of Narasimha
70001077.description: A divine avatar said to have the head of a lion and the body of a man. Believed to be the divine beast called Narasimha originally found in Hindu mythology. Narasimha is an avatar of the God Vishnu.

quests.name: Statue with the head of a lion

70001078.name: Akshobhya
70001078.description: One of the Amitabha from Buddhist teachings. The name means unmoving or solid in Sanskrit. Whether it evolved from that or the reverse, Akshobhya is said to possess a strong and stubborn resolve and fearsome power.

70001079.name: Ratnasambhava
70001079.description: One of the Amitabha from Buddhist teachings. He teaches that everything has value and that all existence is equal.

70001080.name: Amitabha
70001080.description: One of the Amitabha from Buddhist teachings. The name means immeasurable light and immeasurable life in Sanskrit. Said to wrap the world in sweet light.

70001081.name: Amoghasiddhi
70001081.description: One of the Amitabha from Buddhist teachings. The name means there is no emptiness, and achievement itself is important.

70001082.name: The Statue of Gautama Buddha
70001082.description: A statue of Buddha, the founder of Buddhism. Sakyamuni was born into a famous family, but later left it. It is said that when he emerged into the world, he could walk and talk.

70001083.name: The Statue of Guan Yin
70001083.description: Often found in repose near statues of Amitabha. Since she was said to save all and to fulfill all, she is often depicted as inhuman having many heads and many arms. Basically, however, she has one face and two arms.

70001084.name: Karmawibhangga
70001084.description: One of the Buddhist scriptures. Karmavibhangga or Law of Karma teaches what awaits wrong doers in the after life. It is depicted in 160 relief images in the ruins of Borobudur.

70001085.name: Buddha with Naga
70001085.description: An image of Buddha seated in a kneeling position on a coiled snake. The snake is called Mucilinda, and is said to have protected the meditating Buddha from seven days of wind and rain.

70001086.name: The Relief of Lakshmi
70001086.description: A statue of Lakshmi in the ruins of Angkor. You can find many statues of Goddesses in Angkor. The statue of this Goddess was carved from a column of bricks.

70001087.name: The Relief of Hanuman
70001087.description: A relief of Hanuman who appears in the Ramayana. This appears to be a carving of the battle with the devil Ravahna who also appears in the Ramayana.

70001088.name: The Statue of Prajnaparamita
70001088.description: A statue using the queen of Jayavarman VII as a model. Since an avatar of Amitabha can be seen in the head part, it is likely a religious statue.

70001089.name: The Statue of Garuda
70001089.description: A God bird in the Hindu religion. It is said to fly through the sky with Vishnu on its back. There are many in the Hindu countries that believe strongly in Garuda.

70001090.name: Lokesvara Statue
70001090.description: A Buddhist statue made of bronze after the age of Angkor. After the rule of Jayavarman VII, Mahayana Buddhism lost the support of the people, so this copper statue was changed to Shiva, carving off the Buddha and what he held.

70001091.name: Relief of a Goddess
70001091.description: A statue of a goddess carved into a column in the Angkor ruins. It has the same enigmatic, warm smile that you can find in Da Vinci's works or Raphael's mother and child drawings. However, much of Angkor, including this statue, was carved out of very brittle sandstone.

70001092.name: Wagaru Dhammath
70001092.description: The oldest laws of Indo-China, compiled by King Wareru of the Pegu dynasty. The writings are organized in an extremely easy to understand manner, and still have affect today.

70001093.name: Rainbow in the Sea
70001093.description: A moonstone with the most pronounced plays of colour. To a backdrop of clear blue, there are portions that twinkle occasionally in seven colours. Someone who saw this said that it looked just like a rainbow in the sea, and that is where it got its name.

70001094.name: Catacombs' Lithograph
70001094.description: Lithograph found deep in the Catacombs. There seems to be letters engraved on it, but they cannot be read as the surface is terribly scratched.

70001095.name: Costume of a Heavenly Maiden
70001095.description: Clothing worn for the role of Apusara in the traditional Apusara Dance. The dancers clothing is red, blue, green, and white, but the role of Apusara is always white. The exquisite embroidery and flamboyant adornments make the dancing girls look like a angels.

70001096.name: Nagarakretagama
70001096.description: A historical record compiled by the court poet Prapanca of Majapahit. He precisely described scenes from Majapahit's golden age.

70001097.name: Wayang Kulit
70001097.description: Traditional shadow plays that have been acted out since ancient times on Java. Leather dolls are used. In the native language, Wayang means shadow, and Kulit means leather. The Wayang Kulit Puruo, including Mahabharata and Ramayana, performances are common, but Java legends and folk tales are also performed.

70001098.name: Gamelan
70001098.description: Metal instruments used since ancient times on Java. Plectrums are used to pluck metal keys, and the resonance is adjusted manually for performances. It is often used as an accompaniment to Wayang Kulit, but also for performances at ceremonies or rituals.

70001099.name: Bird Beads
70001099.description: Eye-beads said to have been created as far back as 200 years ago. They are in an extremely good condition. On one side, a bird floats into view, and on the other side a design representing sunlight floats up. This is a superb item with its deep blue colour and soft creamy white.

quests.name: Treasure of the bird and sun

70001100.name: The Head of Jayavarman VII
70001100.description: The head of a statue of Jayavarman VII, the king of the Angkor kingdom. Due to vandalism and heartless destruction, the statue from the head down was totally destroyed. Jayavarman was known as being valiant and brought the dynasty many victories. He was also very deeply religious, as can be seen by his building of the Angkor Thom.

70001101.name: The Glittering Star
70001101.description: A highly polished ruby with a white star visible within. That star seems to float when in the sunlight. Perhaps a star was imprisoned in it.

70001102.name: Padparadscha
70001102.description: A sapphire with a mysterious colour that is neither pink nor orange. It is produced only in very few places on Ceylon. Padparadscha is Sanskrit for lotus flower. These earrings have an exceedingly fine design using the lotus as their motif.

70001103.name: The Fascinating Fruit
70001103.description: A tourmaline mixed with faint green and bright red. You can compare the colour to a watermelon. There are actually many different colours of tourmaline; often times multiple colours are mixed into one raw stone.

70001104.name: Torenias
70001104.description: A small flower whose diameter is only 2 cm. It has petals that cover the centre. There are a variety of colours, such as powder blue, pink, and yellow.

70001105.name: Aerides
70001105.description: A plant with a hanging stem and small grain like flowers attached. The flowers come in pink, white, and yellow. They give off a powerful aroma.

ornaments.name: Aerides with White Urn on Table

70001106.name: Moth Orchids
70001106.description: The many flowers in bloom look like hordes of butterflies in flight. They grow wild, clinging to the trees of the jungle.

70001107.name: Cymbidiums
70001107.description: In Greek, the name is taken from two words that mean boat and shape, giving it its other common name, Boat Orchid. The inner section of the plants curls making it resemble a small boat. The flower comes in many different colors.

ornaments.name: Cymbidiums with White Urn on Table

70001108.name: Caucasus Beetle
70001108.description: A large insect with three long horns. Its body, which exceeds 10 cm, is solid and has a strong lustre. Its claws are sharp and it likes to fight.

quests.name: Soldiers in the palm of your hand

70001109.name: Atlas Beetle
70001109.description: An insect with three long horns. It has a black, shiny, large body. It is aggressive, and moves very quickly.

70001110.name: Five Horned Beetle
70001110.description: The insect has one long horn growing out, and four short horns. It has a long trunk, and the wings have a brownish colour.

70001111.name: Giraffe Stag Beetle
70001111.description: A large insect that can grow to exceed 10 cm. The long scissors on the head are powerful and are used to intimidate and attack its enemies.

70001112.name: Dorcus Bucephalus
70001112.description: This insect has a solid body with bent, fat, short scissors. It is extremely ferocious.

70001113.name: Giant Cicada
70001113.description: The highest class of cicada that can grown up to 10 cm, and when its wings are spread, can be as big as 20 cm.

70001114.name: Idea Lynceus
70001114.description: A beautiful butterfly, which is large and flies in an elegant manner. It lives near water in forests.

70001115.name: Purple Spotted Swallowtail
70001115.description: A beautiful butterfly living in New Guinea. It has wings that sparkle like gems, and flutters quickly through the air in groups.

quests.name: Real or a dream?
quests.location: Island of New Guinea South Coast

70001116.name: Common Green Birdwing
70001116.description: A butterfly with wings sporting large, black patterns with golden edges. When it spreads its wings, it can be as large as an adult's palm.

70001117.name: Bhutan Glory
70001117.description: A mysterious butterfly with a sparkling hue and projections resembling three tails at the bottom of its wings. On its black wings it has white patterns that resemble waves, and the bottoms of its wings are red.

70001118.name: Great Argus
70001118.description: This bird is used to people, and is easy to rear. Males and females are very friendly. Males raise and swing their long tail wings to interest females. It is captivating to watch them.

70001119.name: Victoria Crowned Pigeon
70001119.description: This bird lives on New Guinea, and the small, surrounding islands. A large dove that grows larger than 70 cm, it can't fly, and can only jump several meters into the air.

quests.name: Beautiful head
quests.location: Island of New Guinea South Coast

70001120.name: Palm Cockatoo
70001120.description: This bird lives in tropical rain forests and open forests. They are covered in black feathers. You can see red skin on the cheeks. The top of the head has a long crest. It has a long, strong beak and is able to crack the hard shells of palm fruit for food.

70001121.name: Eclectus Parrot
70001121.description: This bird's feather colours are completely different between males and females. Males have bright green, females are deep red. They are extremely intelligent, and have a gentle temperament, making them easy to raise.

70001122.name: Great Hornbill
70001122.description: This bird has an extremely large body. They make a lot of noise when they flap their wings, enough to drown out the cries and calls of other animals. When breeding season comes, the female will crawl into a hole in the nest and the male will go out and get food alone for the female and their offspring. The hardship they face is unimaginable, and occasionally the male bird starves to death.

70001123.name: Sunbeam Snake
70001123.description: A snake that has scales that shine like a rainbow as the light changes. They burrow a nesting hole in the ground and eat frogs and small mammals.

70001124.name: Flying Lizard
70001124.description: A lizard that glides from tree to tree using a membrane that stretches out on both sides of its stomach. The membrane is supported by its bones.

70001125.name: Tokay Gecko
70001125.description: A lizard with a blue body and orange spotted patterns. Its call sounds like Tokkei. It eats tree insects and mice.

70001126.name: Flying Lemur
70001126.description: A monkey covered with a membrane from its neck to its hands and feet and tail. Using the membrane at the tips of its fingers, it glides from tree to tree. Sometimes it can sail as far as 100 meters or more.

70001127.name: Tarsier
70001127.description: A monkey with large pupils that make it look like its wearing glasses. Instead of moving its eyes, it can rotate its head all the way around to see behind itself.

70001128.name: Flying Frog
70001128.description: Different from other frogs, this one has webs on its front feet, too. With them, it is able to glide quite a long distance when it jumps from the top of a tree. It has four long legs, and is adapted perfectly to climbing trees.

70001129.name: Flying Snake
70001129.description: A tree-dwelling snake that eats lizards and frogs. When trying to flee a predator, it will widen its ribs to make its body flat so that it can wriggle its body and glide away.

70001130.name: Proboscis Monkey
70001130.description: A monkey that lives on Borneo island. Males have a large, droopy nose. They like being near water, and their feet are webbed.

70001131.name: Gibbon
70001131.description: A monkey that lives primarily in the trees. Its large hands grasp branches so it can swing from place to place using its body like a pendulum. It eats fruit.

70001132.name: Dhole
70001132.description: They live in troupes of about 10 in forests and grasslands. They track their prey by sense of smell and capture and eat wild hogs and antelope.

70001133.name: Babirusa
70001133.description: In the native tongue, Babirusa means pig and deer. One characteristic is the tusks that grow through the skin from the upper jaw. Males use their fangs to fight with each other.

70001134.name: Komodo Dragon
70001134.description: A large lizard that can grow as big as 3 meters. It has a heavy, solid body, and a long, fat tail. Even though it's large, it is nonetheless very fast, and catches and eats deer and wild boar. Its tongue is forked, giving it the appearance of breathing fire.

70001135.name: Orangutan
70001135.description: This word means man of the forest in the language of the natives of the area. The male's cheek pouches enlarge as they grow, and they also grow beards. Most of their lives are spent in the tree tops. They eat, sleep, and breed in the trees.

70001136.name: Sun Bear
70001136.description: A small bear of approximately 1.5 meters. The skin around their necks is loose, so they can escape by wriggling their bodies if attacked from behind, and then launch a counter attack.

quests.name: Bear as small as a child

70001137.name: Malayan Tapir
70001137.description: The black and white coloring gives these animals a distinctive appearance. They eat a variety of plants in the swamp lands and other areas near water. Their offspring have white stripe patterns.

70001138.name: Sambar Deer
70001138.description: A deer with a dark brown coat of fur. Males have antlers that branch into three sections that are one meter long. They are nocturnal and eat a variety of plants.

70001139.name: Banteng
70001139.description: A cow over 2 meters long. It comes in various colours, like white and brown and male horns can grow as long as 70 cm. It is also raised as livestock.

70001140.name: Finless Porpoise
70001140.description: This porpoise has a expanded forehead resembling that of a dolphin. It lives mainly along coasts, and can be found at inlets and upstream in rivers.

70001141.name: Glass Catfish
70001141.description: This fish protects itself from predators by making itself transparent. You can clearly see the bones, eyes, and digestive system.

70001142.name: Long Horned Cowfish
70001142.description: This fish's body is angular and shaped like a box. It has small projections above its eyes. It blows water into the sand on the sea floor to chase out prey for food.

70001143.name: The Island of Sumatra
70001143.description: An island south of the Malay peninsula. Its proximity has caused the flora and fauna closely resemble that found on the peninsula. The island has been used since ancient times by various merchants as an important trading point between the East and West.

quests.name: Island to the south of the channel

70001144.name: The Andaman Sea
70001144.description: The sea located on the East side of the Andaman island. The water is very clear and you can find many extremely colourful coral and fish. There are countless islands that dot the sea area. A seafaring people called the Moken live by travelling from island to island.

70001145.name: The Malay Peninsula
70001145.description: A peninsula positioned north of the island of Sumatra. It is the homeland of the Malay people and has served as an important point for commerce since ancient times. A massive and dense forest covers a large area of the continent where animals and plants that cannot be found anywhere else live in abundant varieties.

quests.name: Important trade points between East & West

70001146.name: The Straits of Malacca
70001146.description: The strait passing between the Malay Peninsula and the island of Sumatra. This strait is an important passage for east and west trade but it's very narrow, and the water is extremely shallow. Also, because there are many hidden reefs and shoals, sailors must be particularly attentive and careful when passing through.

quests.name: Narrow Path to the Eastern Islands

70001147.name: The Sunda Strait
70001147.description: The strait passing between the island of Sumatra and Java. The sea lane is very narrow, so sailing it is extremely difficult. Small islands, including volcanic islands, are numerous in the vicinity.

70001148.name: Borneo Island
70001148.description: A giant island positioned east of the straits of Malacca. In the Indonesian language it is called Kalimantan. The general area is mountainous and the forms of life there range from large animals to small insects. There are abundant mineral resources and diamond veins in the area, but because the island is covered in a dense forest, it has yet to be developed.

quests.name: Investigate - New World east of Malacca

70001149.name: Java Island
70001149.description: An island positioned southeast of the island of Sumatra. The island is long and narrow running from south to east. It is mountainous, with many volcanoes. In the past, Buddhism and Hinduism were prominent, but it appears lately Islamic teachings are taking root.

70001150.name: The Java Sea
70001150.description: The sea spreading out between the Java and Borneo islands. It has shoals and is a good fishing ground, so many of the local fishing vessels sail the area. The small islands in the Java sea are generally low lying, and there are many salt fields.

70001151.name: The Karimata Strait
70001151.description: The strait stretching west of Borneo. There are shoals but the waves are tranquil. In recent years, there have been many reports of pirates lurking in the area.

70001152.name: The Gulf of Thailand
70001152.description: The giant bay spreading east of Gia Dinh, also called the Gulf of Siam. The waters are shallow and it has a low salt content because of the large rivers that flow into it. There is a mangrove forest along the shore, making this a great fishing ground.

quests.name: Large bay in western Gia Dinh

70001153.name: Celebes Island
70001153.description: A complex-shaped island positioned east of Borneo. It is generally mountainous. The abundant variety of animals that live here are different from those to the west of Borneo. The cultures of the people that live on this island are dramatically different depending on location.

70001154.name: The Makassar Strait
70001154.description: The strait passing between Borneo and Celebes. It has been an important point of trade since ancient times. Makassar has a particularly enormous bay, so it has prospered as a base for trade.

70001155.name: Mindanao Island
70001155.description: An island located in the northeast quadrant of Southeast Asia. Since ancient times, it has had contact with Arab merchants, is controlled by the Islamic forces, but it has also felt Spanish influence since Magellan's arrival at Cebu.

70001156.name: Luzon Island
70001156.description: An island located in the northeast quadrant of Southeast Asia. It has prospered because of the trade between India and Arabia. Although it is a rather mountainous island, it has a variety of agricultural crops.

70001157.name: The Sulu Sea
70001157.description: This sea is surrounded by the islands of Luzon, Borneo, and Mindanao, giving it a closed off feel and allowing it to develop many forms of life you will not find anywhere else. There are also many coral reefs.

70001158.name: The Philippine Sea
70001158.description: The sea located east of the Mindanao and Luzon islands. Filled with brightly coloured fish, it is extremely beautiful but is subject to intense storms when summer arrives.

quests.name: Investigation of sea east of Manila

70001159.name: The Celebes Sea
70001159.description: The sea to the north of Celebes. This area is known for its abundant sea life, but the waters are deep and waves are high, making for complex sea currents. Sea traffic in this area never ends as it is a passage for interaction between the surrounding islands.

70001160.name: The Molucca Sea
70001160.description: A sea located east of Celebes. There are many islands, and each has its own unique people living there. Also, the area is known for producing treasured spices.

70001161.name: The Maluku Strait
70001161.description: The strait located on the eastern side north of Celebes. With its complex topography, pirates have been active here from long, long ago.

70001162.name: The Flores Sea
70001162.description: The sea spreading south of Celebes. The waters are warm, and the waters have a high salinity, which has given birth to many unique forms of marine life. There are many unusual and intriguing animals on the small islands in the region.

70001163.name: The Banda Sea
70001163.description: The sea southeast of Celebes Island. It is said that there are more than 200 small islands in the area. One of these islands may hold the source of those treasured spices.

70001164.name: Timor Island
70001164.description: An island positioned to the far east in the middle of the Lesser Sunda Islands. There is not much rain here, so this land is not suitable for agriculture. However, highly valuable and fragrant sandalwood is produced here.

70001165.name: The Greater Sunda Islands
70001165.description: The islands composed of the islands of Sumatra, Java, Borneo, and Celebes. Because of the transitioning of many groups of people and dynasties from long ago, cultures and religions have become varied over time and by location.

70001166.name: The Lesser Sunda Islands
70001166.description: The collective name of the comparatively small islands east of Java. Because there are so many small islands, it is difficult to know what they all hold. Each island has its own unique culture.

70001167.name: The Moluccas Islands
70001167.description: The island chain east of Celebes Island. For a long time, the origins of the spice, clove, was unknown. But since it was learned that it comes from the Moluka Islands, these islands have become known as the spice islands.

70001168.name: The Arafura Sea
70001168.description: The shallow sea located southwest of New Guinea. They say that if you head south from this sea, you will encounter a very large land mass.

70001169.name: The Island of New Guinea
70001169.description: An island east of Timor, large enough to be mistaken for a continent. There is a high mountain range that dominates the central portion, so there is a big difference in air temperature between the highlands and lowlands. Depending on the location on the island, people speak different languages and have different cultures.

70001170.name: Berau Bay
70001170.description: A narrow bay sandwiched between two land projections shaped like a bird's beak. Innumerable islands can be seen to the west.

70001171.name: Cenderawasih Bay
70001171.description: A bay to the southeast of New Guinea. There is an island in a position like a lid. In that area sailors must be constantly vigilant against pirate attacks.

70001172.name: New Britain Island
70001172.description: A large island east of New Guinea. The island is covered by a tropical rain forest. The island belongs to a volcanic belt giving this island a different feel from that of New Guinea. The seas near these volcanoes are said to bubble as though they were boiling.

70001173.name: Guam Island
70001173.description: A small island positioned east of Manila and north of New Guinea. It is said to be the first island that Magellan found on his 99th day sailing the Pacific Ocean.

quests.name: At the limit of the Pacific

70001174.name: The Pacific Ocean
70001174.description: When Magellan left the Magellan strait, he named the sea this saying it was much more tranquil than the Atlantic Ocean. The Ocean is much wider than Magellan estimated.

70001175.name: The Mekong River
70001175.description: A mighty river flowing near Gia Dinh. The source of the river is high up in the northern mountains, but it is an incredibly long river which makes it difficult to survey. Generally, the river is shallow, but it is not possible to travel upstream on it.

70001176.name: The Chao Phraya River
70001176.description: A large river with an inlet deep in the bay that expands west of Gia Dinh. Downstream, floating rice is produced using the abundant amounts of water. It is often used as a canal.

70001177.name: Bangka Island
70001177.description: An island positioned east of the Strait of Malacca. As with other islands in this area of the sea, beautiful coral reefs expand to envelop the island.

70001178.name: Billiton Island
70001178.description: An island positioned east of the Strait of Malacca. It has been known for its high-quality ore production since ancient times. This is why you can find there plates and bowls from lands far north of the island.

quests.name: Island that lies in a channel

70001179.name: Catacombs in the Cathedral
70001179.description: Catacombs built under the Cathedral. Starting with the discovery on the Italian peninsula, catacombs are being found under several churches in Europe. A few number have been confirmed in cities of France, such as Bordeaux.

70001180.name: Ca Mau Peninsula
70001180.description: A peninsula west of Gia Dinh. This is an area that prospered as an essential point for trade with the north since ancient times. Because this is an expansive wetland area, very advanced irrigation technologies are required to conduct agriculture.

70001181.name: Cebu Island
70001181.description: A long and narrow island running north to south between Luzon and Mindanao islands. Magellan used this island as a base for his circumnavigations westward. At Cebu, Magellan fought with Lapu-Lapu, chief of the natives of Mactan island to the east, and lost his life.

70001182.name: Cusco
70001182.description: The central city of the Incan Empire. Cusco means navel in the native language. It was built by stacking giant, smooth, large rocks so finely that you cannot even fit the tip of your fingernail between them. The technology is striking.

70001183.name: The Pampas of Jumana
70001183.description: A high plain at the western foot of the Andes mountains in the centre of the South American continent. The desert is expansive, but you can see depressions here and there. It seems that they are not just simple depressions...

70001184.name: The Bow of Pachacuti
70001184.description: A bow said to have been used by Pachacuti, the Emperor of the Incan Empire. Pachacuti defeated the Chanka tribe with which his people had been fighting since the time of his father. He is the king accredited with rebuilding Cusco after the great attrition brought on by their battles.

70001185.name: The Shoulder Bag of Chasqui
70001185.description: Chasquis were those with the responsibility of distributing information to remote regions. The information was carried on a rope called a Quipu which is unique to the Incan people, and by word of mouth. Chasquis are said to have been able to run 200 km in a single day. They had unusually strong legs.

70001186.name: Line of Chieftan's Clothes
70001186.description: Traditional clothing used when a chief is elected in one of the numerous tribes of people that lived on the South American continent. The Incan empire claimed a vast area of land, but allowed tribes to rule themselves if they had an existing system of government. In this way, the tribes did not lose any of their traditions and uniqueness.

70001187.name: Gold Discus
70001187.description: A yellow gold disk patterned on the sun god Inti of the Quechuan tribe governed by the Incan Empire. This disk was found at the Qurikancha, the temple to the sun god, in every region of the Inca empire. The disk was also worn as an ornament by the king.

70001188.name: Inca Stone Walls
70001188.description: Smooth and beautifully shaped stones. Something this big would pose a problem in stacking and conveying, but these stones were precisely stacked without even the slightest gaps. How on earth did they build that?

70001189.name: Festival of Goldwork
70001189.description: A ceremonial bowl made using a lot of gold. Although the Incas didn't pay it much heed, it is so valuable that heartless people from foreign countries would steal it.

70001190.name: Bone Flute
70001190.description: A flute made from livestock bones. It was probably used for Incan ceremonies. Probably the bone of a domesticated llama or alpaca.

70001191.name: Copper Mask
70001191.description: Gold and silver has been used as ornaments in South America for quite a while, but copper has been in use for even longer. As this mask was either the property of a king, or part of his burial items, we can guess how valuable copper was then.

70001192.name: Shell
70001192.description: The main Incan towns were high in elevation, and were quite far from the sea. However, the Chasqui delivered fresh marine products high into the mountains. Also, the shells from shellfish had beautiful colours, so they were used for this kind of ornamentation.

70001193.name: Short Poncho
70001193.description: Cloth made using the fur from alpacas and llamas, as well as bird feathers. It was quilted lengthwise and a hole made in the centre so the wearer could pull it over their head. It is wrapped by a cord around the waist and the wearer can stretch out their arms. It could be found in many extremely vibrant colors like red, blue, green, and yellow.

70001194.name: Moai of Hotumatua
70001194.description: A statue of King Hotumatua, the legendary king of Rapa Nui. The king believed in a dream experienced by the philosopher Hau Maka and decided to take a sea voyage. Before long, he arrived at this land. No one is completely sure why this statue was made and what it means.

70001195.name: Hau Maka's Wand
70001195.description: This is a staff said to have been used by the philosopher Hau Maka who asked King Hotumatua to come to Rapa Nui. In a dream he saw himself flying towards the rising sun and learned of the beauty and bounty of the land he reached. He recommended to the king that he move there because it was land right for the king to rule.

70001196.name: The Moai of Ahu Akivi
70001196.description: Statues of the seven aids sent ahead as an advance group before the move to Rapa Nui. Other statues are all facing the direction inland, but these Moai look to the sea. According to legend, they are looking back at what they once called their home.

70001197.name: Te Pito Kura
70001197.description: A place known as the navel of light. The Moai stand around it staring at the white, smooth oval stone. Although the meaning is not completely known, it does seem to be sacred.

70001198.name: Rano Raraku
70001198.description: Rano means volcano, and Raraku means carve the ground. It is the location at the base of the volcano where moai were created. Nearby, you can see many unfinished moai.

70001199.name: Rongorongo
70001199.description: A tablet written with the characters of Rongo-rongo, the unique script of Rapa Nui. The name means the trees that speak. With the Rapa Nui island people, only people of a certain craft could read these characters. There are fewer, so the number of people that can read it gradually decrease each year.

70001200.name: Kallawaya's Medical Herb Jar
70001200.description: Kallawaya were a group of shaman who lived in the Andes mountains. They played the role of doctor and philosopher, and were close to the people of the Andes. The Kallawaya had a deep understanding of medicinal plants and they prepared medicines for their patients from the wild grasses that grew in the mountain fields.

70001201.name: Konopa
70001201.description: Many South America people made sacrifices to the gods they followed. Konopa are the carved effigy of the animals used in sacrifices. Often domesticated animals such as llamas and alpacas were sacrificed and their bones and hair were placed in the Konopa.

70001202.name: Ceremonial Cup
70001202.description: In each of the farming villages of the Andes, this cup was shared as a rite for promising union. The two cows at the bottom of the cup were said to increase the strength of the people promising their union.

70001203.name: The Utensils of Accla
70001203.description: Accla are the women that served in the religious practices of the Incan empire. Nice-looking young girls that were not yet 10 years of age were selected, regardless of their family or blood line. The products made by the Accla supported the basic economy of the Inca empire.

70001204.name: Ceremonial Earthenware
70001204.description: An earthenware vessel said to have been used as a sacred vessel in Andes temples. Perhaps this served the corn based alcohol called chicha.

70001205.name: Illas
70001205.description: Similar to the Konopa, the illas was an idol of animals that were sacrificed to their gods. They were smaller than the Konopa and simplified. Many are made of white stone, and do not have much detailed adornment, but are adorable. This makes you understand just how close domestic animals were.

70001206.name: Painted Wooden Mask
70001206.description: This is a wooden mask, and is a rare artifact in the Andes. It is said to have been modeled after the idol in the temple near Lake Titicaca. There are radiating lines like sunlight around the face.

70001207.name: Picture of a Bird Man
70001207.description: On Rapa Nui, there are believers of Tangata Manu, the bird man that is the metamorphosis of a god called Makemake. It is said that the birdman has extremely strong spiritual powers and those that receive the honour to be called a birdman are given total control over the island for one year.

70001208.name: The Statue of Makemake
70001208.description: Makemake is a god that was worshiped from on Rapa Nui before Moai. Those given the honour of becoming a birdman (Tangata Manu), who are said to be Avatars of Makemake, were given control of the island. This led to Makemake becoming a central religious figure among those worshipped by on Rapa Nui.

70001209.name: Pin
70001209.description: Metal pins that held back a woman's cape or shawl. Pins worn by people with high status were highly decorated and had rich decorations.

70001210.name: The Club of an Inca Warrior
70001210.description: A general weapon used by an Incan warrior. The handle was wound using colourful animal fur, and a stone was bound to the tip.

70001211.name: Gold Bracelet
70001211.description: A bracelet made using ample amounts of gold. Seems like it may have been owned by an aristocrat. It does not seem to be old, but made quite recently.

70001212.name: Silver Bracelet
70001212.description: In South America, silver-working has increased in recent years. They say that south of the Incan roads there are mountains of treasures...

70001213.name: Gold Bowl
70001213.description: A gold bowl found outside of Cusco. In locations where gold is abundant, not only the emperor, but also aristocrats as well dined out of gold bowls and cups. It seems that people of the general classes did not enjoy such privilege.

70001214.name: Chibcha Golden Dress
70001214.description: Clothing of the people said to be the origin of the legends of the golden country. It is said that the chief performed a ritual where he covered his body in gold dust and jumped into a lake. It would seem natural then, for people who lived with so much gold to be known as the golden people.

70001215.name: Star Flower
70001215.description: A pink gem found on the west coast of South America. It is called the Incan Rose. It has bright colours like a flower, and shines like the light of a star, driving away any Fatigue and wrapping you in a simple, warm, glow.

70001216.name: The Spirit of Umina
70001216.description: An emerald the size of an ostrich egg said to have been owned by the Incan emperor Pachacuti. Believed to have been picked up from the people who were conquered in the North Andes. Today, it lays quiet, deep in the Somondoco as an important ritual tool of the Chibcha people.

70001217.name: The Treasure of Huayna Capac
70001217.description: The treasure of the Incan Emperor Huayna Capac who was obsessed with gaining control of the Quito region, a land to the north of the Incan empire. After gaining control, the Emperor himself bestowed it on the region, but in the confusion caused by the arrival of the Europeans, its whereabouts were lost.

quests.name: Proof of the former king's rule

70001218.name: Shell Earrings
70001218.description: Something from the middle period of Andean civilization. Shells and ore were broken to make mosaic images, and these were fitted to wooden frames. This simple but beautiful craftsmanship must have been very popular with the people of other regions because it can be found everywhere. It must have been distributed somehow.

70001219.name: Gold Goblet
70001219.description: Such metal items can be found all over the Andes. It is certain that the manufacture of metal objects was established a very long time ago. You can find regional styles and clear differences in the gold work in every region.

70001220.name: Gold Knife
70001220.description: A knife called a tumi. In Quechuan, it means semicircular blade. Most of the handles on these knifes are shaped like small figures of gods, and are not for general daily use. They are made for ceremonial use.

70001221.name: Golden Arms
70001221.description: A gold crafted arm said to have been made as a burial item. Bird and beast patterns are formed on the arm, and a soldier pattern appears on the shield. The workmanship is extremely detailed. We can see from the traces in the deep metal work that they had a high technical level.

70001222.name: The Gold and Turquoise Pendant
70001222.description: A simple pendant made of gold and turquoise. Turquoise was considered to be something sacred, so perhaps this pendant was made for some type of ceremony.

70001223.name: Gold Headdress
70001223.description: An elaborate head adornment made of gold and turquoise. It seems to be for ceremonies or rituals. By placing the pale blue turquoise on his head, perhaps the wearer has the power to drive off evil powers.

70001224.name: Silver Ornament of Executioner
70001224.description: A burial article made from an alloy of silver, and shaped in a semicircle. When shaken, a ball at the circular end makes a sound. Maybe this was used in rituals that needed sounds.

70001225.name: Mana
70001225.description: Mana is the power of god and spirits. This stone has an incredibly strong aura of mana. So powerful that the islanders avoid talking about it. The stone is a little warm to the touch, and easily crumbles where it is touched. Perhaps it is a harbinger of another existence.

70001226.name: Stone like Egg of a Lizard
70001226.description: An egg-shaped rock that can fit on the palm of your hand. Maybe this is because nearby there is a rock that looks like the bones of a lizard, but this looks exactly like a lizards egg.

maps.name: Bizarre Stone Map
maps.prerequisite: Bones of a Lizard with Two Legs

70001227.name: Bones of a Lizard with Two Legs
70001227.description: A stone resembling lizard bones of a length of approximately 40 cm. However, its back legs are unusually long. If an animal had such long back legs, it would be faster for it to walk on just two legs, and not four.

70001228.name: Brazilian Red Cloak
70001228.description: A plant that blossoms with an abundance of bright red flowers at the tips of its branches. The connection of the tubular flowers makes it looks like a bundle of flames. The large ones can grow as big as 4 meters tall, as high as a tree. It lives in tropical forests in central America.

70001229.name: Firebirds
70001229.description: A flowering plant related to the banana that grows in tropical areas in the New World. Its flowers are a bright red. Some say that its shapes brings to mind a bird of fire. It is also called a false Bird-of-paradise and wild plantain.

quests.name: A flower named after a bird

ornaments.name: Firebirds with White Urn on Table

70001230.name: Jacaranda
70001230.description: A tree with purple flowers that grows in tropical areas in South America. The larger ones can be over 15 meters tall. When the flowering season arrives, the entire plant blossoms with many beautiful flowers, making the whole thing look light purple. The flower's name means beautiful song in Spanish.

70001231.name: Lily of the Incas
