70002768.description: A terrestrial bird that inhabits in South America. Has a fairly long neck and legs. Soft feathers emerge from the base of the bill to form a fan-shaped crest. Can easily run faster than a human in its habitat.

70002769.name: Potoo
70002769.description: A nocturnal mid-sized bird that inhabits South America with large eyes. They spend the day perched on branches with their eyes half closed.

70002770.name: Glass Frog
70002770.description: A frog that inhabits wetlands in South America. The internal viscera, including the heart, liver, and gastrointestinal tract, are visible through the skin, hence the common name.

70002771.name: Surubi
70002771.description: A species of catfish that inhabits the upstream of the Paraguay River. Has black vertical stripes. Its flesh is delicious.

70002772.name: Granulated Catfish
70002772.description: A species of thorny catfish that inhabits in South America. The skin becomes thick and tough as it grows up.

70002773.name: Pantanal
70002773.description: The world's largest tropical wetland area located around the upstream of the Paraguay River. Roughly 80% of the Pantanal floodplains are submerged during the rainy seasons. Essential sanctuaries for a wide variety of plants and animals.

70002774.name: Earthenware of Marajo
70002774.description: Painted earthenware discovered on the island of Marajo located near the mouth of the Amazon River. Geometrical patterns such as spirals are drawn on it.

70002775.name: Brazil Nut Tree
70002775.description: A tall tree native to the Amazon basin. The nuts contain a lot of oil. The fruit shell is fairly heavy.

70002776.name: Guarana
70002776.description: A climbing plant native to the Amazon basin. The fruit's color is red and black seeds can be seen when ripe. The seeds have been known as a dietary supplement among the local people from ancient time.

70002777.name: Guava
70002777.description: A small tree native to the Caribbean, Central America and South America. The fruit were eaten by the local people since ancient times. However, the leaves started to be used for making tea after Guava was introduced to Southeast Asia in the 16th to 17th century.

maps.name: Map of a Tropical Fruit Tree

70002778.name: Ipe
70002778.description: A relatively big tree with a diameter of 60 cm-1 m in Central America and South America. The wood is very tough and heavy, It's also rich in tannins and therefore very resistant to weather and sun. Can be found being used for beams or fulfilling other structural uses where needed outdoors.

70002779.name: Haeterini
70002779.description: A butterfly found in the tropical rainforests in Central and South America. The winds are clear as a glass. The hindwings have faded red and purple patterns.

70002780.name: Army Ant
70002780.description: An ant known for their aggressive predatory foraging groups. They mainly inhabit the tropical rainforests in Central and South America. They are aggressive, and feed on other bigger insects and even birds.

70002781.name: Fire Beetles
70002781.description: A bioluminescent click beetle that inhabits in Central America and South America. The light they emit is said to be the brightest among other bioluminescent insects.

70002782.name: Jabiru
70002782.description: A large stork most common in the Pantanal. An adult jabiru is 120-140 cm long, 2.3-2.8 m across the wings. Their head is featherless.

70002783.name: Great Curassow
70002783.description: A mid-sized bird found in the tropical rainforests in South America. Male birds have curly crests and yellow beaks. As their flying ability is weak, they spend most of their time on the ground or in bushes.

quests.name: A Model of a Cool Hairstyle

70002784.name: White Woodpecker
70002784.description: A species of woodpecker commonly found in the Pantanal. Can perch on vertical surfaces of trees, but don't drill or drum on trees like some other members of the same family.

70002785.name: Picui Ground Dove
70002785.description: A species of dove commonly found in the Pantanal. They have a single blue line on each shoulder. Although they are doves, they are comparable to sparrows in size.

maps.name: Map of a Bird with a Stripe

70002786.name: Buff-necked Ibis
70002786.description: A fairly large ibis commonly found in the Pantanal. Their neck is buffish, their upperparts are grey, and their belly and flight feathers are black.

maps.name: Map of a Bird with a Black Belly

70002787.name: Chopi Blackbird
70002787.description: A black small bird found across South America. They live in groups most of the time. Their call is a loud explosive sound, but the purpose of it is yet to be known.

quests.name: Beautiful Voice That Resounds in South America

70002788.name: Agouti
70002788.description: A 50-70 cm long rodent commonly found in forested and wooded areas in Central and South America. Their appearance is like a squirrel but bigger in size, and has longer legs and a shorter tail. They are active and graceful in their movements.

70002789.name: Paca
70002789.description: A 60-80 cm long rodent with dots and stripes on their sides, that inhabits South and Central America. They are great swimmers and prefer to be near water.

maps.name: Map of an Animal with a Long Face

70002790.name: Kinkajou
70002790.description: A rainforest mammal with a long tail, belonging to the same family as racoons. They spend a majority of their life on trees. Their tail is often used as a 'fifth hand' in climbing. A nocturnal animal.

70002791.name: Peccary
70002791.description: A boar-like mammal found in Central and South America. They live together in groups of 5-15 members. They are known for their habit where one member of the group sacrifices its own life to save the others when being attacked by a predator.

70002792.name: Tufted Capuchin
70002792.description: A monkey that inhabits the northeastern region of South America. They have high levels of intelligence and can use stones as hammers to crack nuts, or use sticks to catch ants.

70002793.name: Squirrel Monkey
70002793.description: A small monkey found in the tropical rainforests of Central and South America. They grow from 25 to 35 cm long, plus a 35 to 42 cm tail. They live together in multi-male/multi-female groups with up to 500 members.

70002794.name: Maned Wolf
70002794.description: The largest canid of South America. It is said that they can run as fast as cheetahs. In folklore, they are believed to be able to kill chickens just by glaring at them.

70002795.name: Giant Armadillo
70002795.description: The largest living species of armadillo found widely throughout the tropical rainforests of South America. They have a typical length of 75-100 cm. Their head and back is covered with armour bands.

maps.name: Map of an Animal with an Armour Shell

70002796.name: Marsh Deer
70002796.description: The largest deer species from South America reaching a length of 2 m, commonly found in the Pantanal. Only the males possess antlers which are ramified and reach a length of 60 cm.

70002797.name: Electric Eel
70002797.description: An electric fish found in the northern region of South America. They produce electricity to catch their prey, and are at the top of the food chain in their habitat.

70002798.name: Four-eyed Fish
70002798.description: A fish that inhabits freshwater and brackish water around the Amazon River mouth. The eyes are positioned on the top of the head, and it floats on the water surface with only the lower half of each eye underwater.

70002799.name: Armoured Catfish
70002799.description: A catfish commonly found in the Amazon River. Their skin is typically hard, hence the name. Contrary to it's looks, they are very delicious.

70002800.name: Tucunare
70002800.description: A tropical, freshwater fish found in the Amazon basin. They have a spot on their tail fins which resembles the eyes on a peacock's tail feathers. Widely consumed as food by the local people.

maps.name: Map of a Fish with Peacock Patterns

70002801.name: Black Caiman
70002801.description: A large crocodilian found in the central region of South America, growing to sizes of at least 5 m. Has dark-coloured, scaly skin. Fierce enough to attack humans.

70002802.name: Trahiras
70002802.description: A fish found commonly found in the Amazon basin. Their appearance is similar to prehistoric fishes such as the coelacanth.

70002803.name: Oxbow Lake
70002803.description: A U-shaped body of water that forms when a wide meander from the main stem of a river is cut off, creating a free-standing body of water. Commonly seen in the Amazon River.

70002804.name: Mystery of Atlantis
70002804.description: A book compiled by John Tradescant as part of the research of Atlantis. It sets forth his interpretation of the disappearance of Atlantis as well as the history of ancient Egypt and ancient Greek, in a logical manner.

quests.name: Those Who Seek and Those Who Lead

70002805.name: Truth of Atlantis
70002805.description: A book compiled mostly by John Tradescant, detailing information gained by deciphering the ancient writing on stone tablets found in the course of his research on Atlantis. Its academic value is extremely high.

quests.name: The Qualifications and Resolve to Know

70002806.name: Future of Atlantis
70002806.description: A book compiled mostly by John Tradescant, written about the facts gained through the field research on Atlantis, regarding the disappearance of Atlantis, and the Atlantean ideologies. It seems it will be in the possession of a certain academic institution.

70002807.name: Morning Glory
70002807.description: A large belt-shaped cloud which can be observed around the world during the morning. Large ones can have a width greater than 1000 km. It rarely occurs and it's cause is unknown.

70002808.name: Rainbow
70002808.description: A semi-circular light band which occurs in the atmosphere. The band consists of 5 to 7 colors. Although it tends to occur after rainfall, the relation between the two events is unknown.

70002809.name: Moonbow
70002809.description: A rainbow which is produced by moonlight, unlike regular rainbows. As the light emitted from the moon is weaker than the sun, the rainbow would appear to be more white. Like a regular rainbow, it often occurs after rainfall.

70002810.name: Tangent Arc
70002810.description: A phenomenon in which an arc-shaped light band occurs around the sun. Like a rainbow, the light band consists of multiple colors. As this phenomenon can only be observed once within several years unlike a rainbow, it is difficult to visually compare the two phenomena.

70002811.name: Noctiluca
70002811.description: A phenomenon in which the sea appears to be glowing due to the emission of light from creatures inhabiting in the sea. As many have seen it when waves occur, people have considered that this phenomenon may have been caused by the impact of waves.

70002812.name: Bioluminescence
70002812.description: The phenomenon in which the sea appears to be glowing at night due to the light being emitted from the organisms in the sea. There are many species of organisms in the sea that emit light. It has been confirmed that in addition to fishes, there are also crustaceans and jellyfishes that are capable of emitting light.

70002813.name: Submarine Volcano
70002813.description: If the water depth is shallow and the eruption is strong, smoke may be emitted from the sea surface. If the eruption is particularly active, it could lead to the formation of an island.

70002814.name: Thick Fog
70002814.description: A phenomenon which occurs when fine water droplets drift in the air. Sometimes the fog is so thick that one may not be able to see more than a few meters ahead. There have been reports that in addition to causing poor visibility, it can also affect the growth of crops.

70002815.name: Haboob
70002815.description: A large sandstorm that occurs in desert areas of northern Africa. It can sometimes be large enough to cover an entire city. As it travels fast, people immediately evacuate and find shelter indoors as soon as it is spotted.

70002816.name: Yellow Sand
70002816.description: The phenomenon in which fine sand travel from Europe and Asia through the wind and land in nearby regions. It can affect the health of crops, local residents, and may even travel across the seas and affect other regions.

70002817.name: Fireball
70002817.description: A phenomenon in which meteors shine brighter than usual while moving. After this phenomenon occurs, it is said that remains of these meteors can sometimes be found.

70002818.name: Meteor Shower
70002818.description: A phenomenon where multiple meteors appear within a short period of time. As meteor showers have a radiation point, it can only be observed at locations with high elevation during nighttime.

70002819.name: Naga Fireball
70002819.description: A phenomenon in which a fireball appears in a river. This phenomenon occurs in places such as the Malay Peninsula. The fireball will rise from the water surface to several hundred meters above the ground and then disappear. It is said that thousands could appear within an hour on a day where this phenomenon frequently occurs.

70002820.name: Halo
70002820.description: A phenomenon in which a thin cloud covers the sun or moon, and an annular band of light occurs. The cause is thought to be because it's near a rainbow, but actual reason is not yet known.

70002821.name: Circumhorizontal Arc
70002821.description: A phenomenon where rainbow colored bands overlaps a thin cloud below the sun. Unlike other optical phenomena, it appears not as a circle but as a horizontal strip.

70002822.name: Polar Stratospheric Clouds
70002822.description: A cloud that appears in higher altitudes than usual. Being hit by sunlight after sunset, it has the color of a pearl. Its other name is nacreous cloud which means mother of pearl.

70002823.name: Noctilucent Cloud
70002823.description: A phenomenon which can only be seen after sunset where clouds appear to be in a pale color. It is presumed that it is due to the clouds being hit by the light from the sun below the horizon, but the details are unknown.

70002824.name: Black Smoker
70002824.description: Like submarine volcanoes, hot water is expelled from the seabed. The zinc and iron contained in the hot water causes a reaction with the seawater and turns black.

70002825.name: Pororoca
70002825.description: A phenomenon in which waves strike the mouth of the river. This mainly occurs in places such as the Amazon River. It is believed to be caused by the overflowing tides. The name means great roar in Tupi.

70002826.name: Sun Dogs
70002826.description: A phenomenon where multiple suns can be seen lined up together. It is thought that the illusions may be caused by the fine particles in the atmosphere, however there is still no clear explanation of this phenomenon.

70002827.name: Viana do Castelo
70002827.description: A town located in the western part of the Iberian Peninsula. It is an important port city for all ships heading towards the open ocean.

70002828.name: Cattaro
70002828.description: A city located on the east side of the Adriatic Sea. The influence of Venice can be seen within design of the city.

70002829.name: Rock-hewn Churches of Lalibela
70002829.description: Rock-hewn churches existing in Ethiopia. The buildings are made through digging into stones which is rarely seen. However, the construction methods of these churches are unknown.

70002830.name: A Stone of Mamucium Fort
70002830.description: A shard of stone that was used in the building of a fort in the middle western parts of the British Isles. It was apparently a part used for building the Mamucium Fort by the ancient Roman Empire.

70002831.name: Pneumatica
70002831.description: A document written by Heron of Alexandria. It describes a mechanism installed in an ancient Egyptian temple which distributes holy water.

quests.name: Beginning of the Steam Engine Research

70002832.name: Hand-knitted Patterned Basket
70002832.description: Hand-knitted basket made in Western Africa. It holds value as an art piece and has colorful patterns knitted on it.

70002833.name: Sphere of Aeolus
70002833.description: Steam engine which is said to be the oldest in the world. A record of this was left by Heron of Alexandria and others. When heat is applied to it, steam is ejected and then converted into torque.

70002834.name: Valiha
70002834.description: Traditional instrument in Madagascar, made of bamboo. As there are similar musical instruments in Southeast Asia, it is presumed that the instrument originates from an instrument being brought in by past residents during the migration from Southeast Asia to Madagascar.

70002835.name: Ancient Soap
70002835.description: Traditional soap made by mixing animal fat with ash. It has a soft and distinctive smell.

70002836.name: Kashaka
70002836.description: A percussion instrument passed down in West Africa. It's composed of two nuts connected with a string with seeds inside the nuts. Hold the string and shake the instrument to create sounds. It's originally made as an instrument to entertain children, but is now locally considered a toy for children.

70002837.name: Flame Angelfish
70002837.description: A fish inhabiting central and western parts of the Pacific Ocean. It lives in reefs and coral reefs. It has a bright and dark orange body with black vertical stripes.

70002838.name: Coconut Crab
70002838.description: A large crustacean. At first glance, it may look like a crab, but it's actually a species of hermit crab. It's an omnivorous creature and eats food ranging from tree nuts to rotting meat. As there has been an overfishing of this species for food purposes, there is a possibility of it requiring protection from becoming extinct.

70002839.name: Red-lipped Batfish
70002839.description: Fish inhabiting near the Galapagos Islands. The way it swims makes it appear as if it is walking on the ocean floor. Its name comes from the color of its lips.

70002840.name: Stone Scorpionfish
70002840.description: A fish inhabiting the eastern part of the Pacific Ocean. Although it has venomous spines, as its color closely resembles the color of reefs, there have been many who have been accidentally pricked by it.

70002841.name: River Mersey
70002841.description: A river flowing in the northwestern part of England. It's used for water supply by places such as Manchester, and when the canal was built, it was also used to support the development of the water industry.

70002842.name: Kiritimati
70002842.description: One of the largest coral reef island in the world, located south of Hawaii. The name means Christmas in the Kiribati language. As British explorer James Cook had reached the island on Christmas eve, the island was given this name.

70002843.name: Khao Phing Kan
70002843.description: Sea stack in Phang Nga bay, across the Andaman Sea. As it is composed of limestone, its current shape is due to being corroded by rain and waves for long periods of time.

70002844.name: Cenote
70002844.description: A fountain created by groundwater pooling on the collapsed ground. Can be found in the limestone area of Yucatan Peninsula. In some cases, the limestone cave sinks in the bottom of the water.

70002845.name: Aldabra
70002845.description: Coral atoll located north of Madagascar Island. In addition to having many turtles inhabit there, various birds and sea turtles also inhabit there.

70002846.name: Caelum
70002846.description: A constellation in the Southern Hemisphere created by Lacaille. The name means chisel in Latin. As it does not contain any bright stars nor does it have any special features to distinguish it, people use the constellation Orion which is located in the South as a center to search in the Southeast direction to find this constellation.

70002847.name: Vela
70002847.description: A constellation in the Southern Hemisphere. As part of this constellation connects with the constellation Carina to form the shape of a cross, it is easy to mistaken this constellation for another.

maps.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
maps.location: Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea

70002848.name: Reticulum
70002848.description: A constellation in the Southern Hemisphere created by Lacaille. The name refers to a reticle, the net of crosshairs at the focus of a telescope eyepiece.

70002849.name: Ruins of Tulum
70002849.description: The ruins of a Mayan walled city. It is one of the last cities of the Mayan civilization to have prospered in trade between the 13th century and 15th century.

quests.name: Port City of the Mayan Civilization

70002850.name: Chajchas
70002850.description: Traditional instrument from Andes typically made with hooves from animals such as llamas. It is worn on the wrist or ankle and creates a sound when shaken.

70002851.name: Gambang
70002851.description: Percussion instrument from Indonesia. It is played by striking the arranged bamboo pieces that are on the diaphragm board.

70002852.name: Pungi
70002852.description: An Indian instrument. You make sounds by breathing in from the gourd. It's used by snake charmers when commanding snakes.

70002853.name: Psychotria Poeppigiana
70002853.description: A shrub that is found in Latin America. It features a bract that resembles human lips. Contrary to their looks, it was used for pain relief in ancient times, and is especially effective for sprains and headaches.

70002854.name: Hydnora Africana
70002854.description: A plant that inhabits the dry regions of southern Africa. As it has no leaves for photosynthesis, it survives by infesting itself onto the roots of other plants to obtain nutrients and water.

70002855.name: Manuka
70002855.description: A tree that originates from the southeast area of Australia and New Zealand archipelago. Its honey and leaves have various medicinal effects.

70002856.name: Nene
70002856.description: A goose which inhabits Hawaii. This species can grow up to be as big as 60cm. The name originates from the sound of its soft call.

70002857.name: Navagio Beach
70002857.description: A cove located on Zakynthos, Greece. It's surrounded by limestone cliffs, white sand beaches and clear blue water.

70002858.name: Punalu'u Beach
70002858.description: A black beach located in Hawaii. The lava expelled from a volcano was crushed finely into black sand and accumulated there to create the beach. The location is famous for being a habitat for sea turtles.

70002859.name: Greensand Beach
70002859.description: A beach located on the south end of Hawaii, in Kau. The sand appears green due to the olivine sand.

70002860.name: Shell Beach
70002860.description: A beach located across Shark Bay on the west coast of Australia. It's composed entirely of small white shells.

70002861.name: Hyams Beach
70002861.description: A beach located in the southeast area of Australia. It's known for its soft and fine white sand which shines brightly.

70002862.name: Sextans
70002862.description: A constellation created by Hevelius. It was named after the Sextant that he lost during a fire.

quests.name: The Sextant of the Night Sky
The Sextant of the Night Sky

70002863.name: Octans
70002863.description: A constellation in the Southern Hemisphere created by Lacaille. Its shape resembles an octant used for star gazing.

70002864.name: Flower-like Nebula of Vela
70002864.description: A nebula which is located near Vela. It's a faint dark nebula which spreads out.

70002865.name: Norma
70002865.description: A constellation in the Southern Celestial Hemisphere created by Lacaille. Its shape resembles a ruler lined up with a finger.

70002866.name: Quadrans Muralis
70002866.description: A constellation created by the French astronomer Lalande. It was named after the telescope he used. In January, a meteor shower can be seen near this constellation.

quests.name: Observation Equipment in the Night Sky

70002867.name: Quadrantids
70002867.description: A meteor shower which appears as if it is shooting out from the constellation, Quadrans Muralis. It can only be seen once a year, and only for a few hours.

70002868.name: Le Havre
70002868.description: Port city in northern France. It's located at the mouth of the Seine river. It's flourishing with trade activity.

70002869.name: Rotterdam
70002869.description: A city facing the North Sea. Located where several rivers such as the Rhine flow into the North Sea. Developed as a port city since the 16th century, it has become the key to Atlantic trading.

70002870.name: Portsmouth
70002870.description: A city in southern Britain Island. It served as a military port during the war with France and the Crusades. After the industrial revolution, the city focused on developing its shipbuilding industry.

70002871.name: Buffalo Jump
70002871.description: The official name of this cliff located in the northwest of North America is 'Head Smashed-in Buffalo Jump.' This place has been used for driving and hunting American bisons that inhabit the nearby grasslands, and old arrowheads can be found here.

70002872.name: Sweat Lodge
70002872.description: A cabin used for a purification ritual popular among the native residents of North America. Inside is filled with scented steam from herbal medicines to pure one's mind and body.

70002873.name: Coup Stick
70002873.description: A winged stick attained by a North American native warrior. It is used for counting coup, a hero's winning of prestige in battles by touching an enemy warrior's stick instead of killing.

maps.name: Map of a Tool Used in Competitions

70002874.name: Rainbow Snail Stone
70002874.description: A stone like an opal found on the east side of Rocky Mountains. Its shape looks like a snail.

70002875.name: Skull of a Fish with Big Jaw
70002875.description: A skull of a giant creature with a strong jaw. It's covered by extremely hard bones. It seems like a fish, but half of its body is still missing.

70002876.name: Bone of a Giant Turtle
70002876.description: A bone of a sea turtle with the overall length of 4m and the width of 5m. The back is not covered by bones but seems to be covered by some kind of skin.

maps.name: Map of Bones of a Large Turtle

70002877.name: Bone of a Flat-torsoed Lizard
70002877.description: A bone of a large lizard-like creature that has a wide torso which is covered by bones like armour.

70002878.name: Bone of a Round-headed Lizard
70002878.description: A bone of a creature like a giant lizard found in the west of North America. Its crown of the head is covered by a dome-shaped 25cm-thick bone.

70002879.name: Bone of a Giant Penguin
70002879.description: A bone of a creature like a giant penguin found in central North America.

maps.name: Map of Bones of a Large Penguin
maps.prerequisite: The Bones of a Giant Shark

70002880.name: Strange Shrimp Stone
70002880.description: A strange-looking stone found in the Burgess Shale located in the northwest region of North America. It looks like an abdomen of a shrimp or a tentacle of some kind of creature.

70002881.name: Stone of a Spiny Bug
70002881.description: A strange-looking stone found in the Burgess Shale located in the northwest region of North America. It looks like a spiny bug, but its identity is unknown.

70002882.name: Sugar Maple
70002882.description: A species of maple native to North America. As its sap is boiled, it becomes maple syrup. Its wood is hard and used as a material for craftwork.

70002883.name: Shark Ray
70002883.description: A marine animal that inhabits in and around the Indian Ocean. Its appearance and way of swimming resemble to those of a shark, but it's considered as a stingray. It has a wide, flat head.

70002884.name: Northern Pika
70002884.description: A type of a bunny that inhabits cold regions in North America and Asia. Its body length is about 18cm, and it has short limbs and round ears.

70002885.name: Xanthidae
70002885.description: A small crab that is distributed over the Indian Ocean and the west of the Pacific Ocean. It's well known as the soft and round shell and poison. The poison's components and amounts vary according to the habitats.

quests.name: Crab that Looks Like a Confectionery

70002886.name: Superb Bird-of-Paradise
70002886.description: A type of Bird-of-Paradise that inhabits in New Guinea. A male has black feathers and a blue winged cover on its chest and waist. It jumps right and left with wings open for courting female's love.

quests.name: Dancing Face
quests.location: Island of New Guinea South Coast

70002887.name: Rocky Mountains
70002887.description: A mountain range located in the western part of the North American continent. It's rich with a wide variety of animals, plants and natural resources.

quests.name: Mountain Range Stretching in North America

70002888.name: Mount Elbert
70002888.description: The highest peak of the Rocky Mountains located in the west of the North American continent. It rises 4,400m above the sea level.

70002889.name: Burgess Shale
70002889.description: One of the sedimentary layers found in the west of the North American continent. Various strange stones considered as some creatures' bones have been found here.

70002890.name: Red Bay
70002890.description: A bay located in the northeast part of the North American continent. It's a natural harbor once used as a base for whale hunting.

70002891.name: Lake Erie
70002891.description: One of the lakes located in the northeast part of the North American continent. It has a large surface area, but its water depth is less than 20m in average. It feeds a major waterfall downstream.

70002892.name: Lake Ontario
70002892.description: One of the lakes located in the northeast part of the North American continent. A massive waterfall is located at the southwest part of the lake. It also drains via Saint Lawrence River from the northeast side of the lake.

70002893.name: Cuesta
70002893.description: A type of landforms often found in the northeast area of the North American continent. A slope crossed with hard stratum and soft stratum eroding became a landform of continuous loose slopes and steep cliffs. Niagara Falls is believed to have been formed because of these cliffs.

70002894.name: Fornax
70002894.description: A constellation named by Lacaille. It's modeled after a furnace heating a flask.

70002895.name: Puppis
70002895.description: A constellation in the southern sky, named by Lacaille. It's modeled after the stern of the ship named Argo from Greek mythology.

70002896.name: Bird-shaped Nebula of Sagittarius
70002896.description: One of the nebulas with scattered light of Sagittarius. It has a irregular shape and can easily be observed due to its brightness.

70002897.name: Uffington White Horse
70002897.description: A geoglyph presumed to be made 3000 years ago with the length of about 110 meters.

70002898.name: Rock Carvings in Tanum
70002898.description: A collection of petroglyphs found in Tanumshede. It's a very precious exhibit which reveals the lifestyles of those who lived during the Bronze Age up to the Iron Age.

70002899.name: Towers of Svaneti
70002899.description: Mysterious towers which can be found in the villages of the Svaneti region, located within the valley of the Caucasus Mountains. The appearance of these towers vary little by little depending on the age that it was built in.

70002900.name: Etchmiadzin Cathedral
70002900.description: A church which is said to have been built under the order of the Archbishop of Armenia after having seen a vision of the descent of Christ. It is known as the world's oldest church.

70002901.name: Cumans Stone Statue
70002901.description: Stone statues created by nomadic people whom inhabited the wide grasslands north of the Black Sea and the Caspian Sea. It has been said that perhaps they may have been modeled after their ancestors.

70002902.name: Russian Calf
70002902.description: Leather produced in Russia around the 18th century. After tanning the skin of reindeers, it is embossed and finished with painting oil made from trees. It features rhombic irregularities due to the embossing and a unique scent from the finish.

70002903.name: Uranometria
70002903.description: A star atlas published in the early 17th century by a German lawyer, Johann Bayer. It contains records of all constellations in the sky. The star atlas features Greek and Roman letters, making it easier to reference.

70002904.name: Messier Catalog
70002904.description: A book about constellations made by the French astronomer, Charles Messier. It is said to include information on all constellations, including nebulas and star clusters.

70002905.name: Long-tailed Tit
70002905.description: A type of bird which exists widely throughout the Eurasian continent. It has several subspecies. It has a short neck, long tail wings, and a round and petite body with a body length of less than 15 centimeters.

70002906.name: Spectacled Cormarant
70002906.description: A large bird that inhabits Bering Island, east of Kamchatka Peninsula. Its white skin is exposed around the eyes as there is no fur located in the area around the eyes.

70002907.name: Gyrfalcon
70002907.description: A bird that inhabits the alpine belt of the North American continent and the northern part of the Eurasian continent. It has a length of approximately 50 cm and when spreading its wings, its width exceeds 1 meter.

70002908.name: Japanese Spider Crab
70002908.description: A type of crab which inhabits the deep seas of East Asia. This type of crab features very long legs; when a grown male crab spreads its legs, it can reach a total width of close to 4 meters.

70002909.name: The Island of Capri
70002909.description: An island located south of Naples. It was once a villa for the emperor of the Roman Empire. The island is surrounded by cliffs and there's also a sea cave on the island.

70002910.name: Blue Grotto
70002910.description: A sea cave in the Island of Capri in southern Italy. When the cave is exposed to light from the entrance, due to its peculiar topography, the interior of the cave appears to shine blue.

70002911.name: St. Lawrence Island
70002911.description: An island located south of the Bering Strait. It is a habitat to many sea animals such as seabirds and walruses.

70002912.name: Volga River
70002912.description: A large river that flows over western Russia that reaches over 3,500 kilometers in length. The fertile river valleys provide large quantities of wheat.

70002913.name: Microscopium
70002913.description: A constellation in the southern sky established by Lacaille. It is named after the scientific instrument, the microscope.

70002914.name: Iapetus
70002914.description: The third largest moon orbiting Saturn after Titan and Rhea. Both the light and dark side of the moon can be clearly distinguished; it may be hard to observe sometimes, depending on its status.

70002915.name: Eta Aquariids
70002915.description: A meteor shower associated with Halley's Comet. It appears to be coming out from the direction of the water jar of the constellation, Aquarius.

maps.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
maps.location: Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea

70002916.name: Ceres
70002916.description: An astronomical object located in the asteroid belt on the outer side of the orbit of Mars. Although it shows similar movements to planets, it is an astronomical object which is smaller than planets.

70002917.name: Beni Hammad Fort
70002917.description: A fortified city said to have been built by the pioneers of the Hammadid dynasty. Although it has been long considered as a ruin, many historical sites still remain.

70002918.name: Gilf Kebir
70002918.description: A sandstone plateau in eastern Sahara. It contains many dried riverbeds, and there are murals left by ancient people along the walls.

quests.name: Plateau Larger than a Country
quests.location: Africa North Coast South Mediterranean Sea

70002919.name: Touareg Pendant
70002919.description: A silver accessory worn by nomadic people inhabiting Western Sahara, Touareg. It resembles a compass and the design vary depending on families and regions. It's passed down from generation to generation.

quests.name: To the End of the Cycle of Revenge

70002920.name: Salon
70002920.description: An instrument used in Indonesian folk music Gamelan. It features a crescent shaped bronze plate fastened with metal fittings and is played by hitting it with either a buffalo horn or a small mallet.

70002921.name: Bone of a Lizard with Upward Spine
70002921.description: The bone of a large lizard-like creature, discovered in northern regions of the African continent. It has a length of about 15 meters, and features a protrusion extending upwards from the spine.

70002922.name: Darkling Beetle
70002922.description: An insect inhabiting the Namib desert in southwest Africa. Due to the uneven shape featured on its back, it is able to gather the water from mists for drinking.

70002923.name: Sand Cat
70002923.description: Small animals which inhabit the desert extending from the Sahara to southwest Asia. Their body size is around 50 centimeters. They have large ears that are covered with hair inside to prevent sand from entering.

70002924.name: Grant's Golden Mole
70002924.description: An animal inhabiting southern Africa. They have a round body with a length of about 8 centimeters. They have long nails on their front legs which are used for digging holes. As they are nocturnal creatures, their eyesight is degenerating.

70002925.name: Desert Plated Lizard
70002925.description: Lizards that inhabit the Namib Desert. To protect itself from the hot sand in the desert, they have the habit of lifting their legs when resting.

70002926.name: Splendid Garden Eel
70002926.description: Fish that inhabits the bottom of shallow seas. Can be found in the Pacific Ocean and the Indian Ocean. It has a maximum body length of 40 centimeters and has yellow and white stripes.

70002927.name: Guelta d'Archei
70002927.description: A valley located in the southern region of the Sahara. Wetlands which inhabit crocodiles are formed from the groundwater flowing out. Additionally, as it was a location in which people have made use of in ancient times, there are also ancient murals remaining in the area.

70002928.name: Black Desert
70002928.description: A desert located in eastern Sahara. The desert features a black color as it is covered with basalt rock. There are also mountains which look like black pyramids scattered within the area.

70002929.name: White Desert
70002929.description: A desert located in Eastern Sahara. It has massive chalk rock formations. Their color is snow-white to cream.

70002930.name: Waw An Namus
70002930.description: A caldera of an ancient volcano located in central Sahara. Has a diameter of approximately 4km. There's also an oasis nearby of which is used as a water supply point for caravans.

70002931.name: Todra Gorge
70002931.description: A majestic valley located in northwest Africa. It features a stunning landscape with cliffs lined up together.

70002932.name: Maya Bay
70002932.description: One of the Phi Phi islands floating on the Andaman Sea. It features a pure white sand beach and a crystal clear sea.

70002933.name: Pyxis
70002933.description: A constellation in the southern sky, established by Lacaille. It's shape resembles a mariner's compass. It is located near the constellations Puppis and Vela, and the location of these constellations affects the masts of ships.

70002934.name: Antlia
70002934.description: A constellation in the southern sky established by Lacaille. Its shape resembles an air pump.

70002935.name: Pallas
70002935.description: An astronomical object located in the asteroid belt on the outer orbit of Mars. It is said to have a size larger than the astronomical object, Ceres.

70002936.name: Meteor Shower of Ganymede
70002936.description: A meteor shower which appear from the direction of the right leg of Aquarius. This activity can be seen for approximately 1 month each year. As there are other meteor showers which occur around the same time, it is rarely spotted by itself.

70002937.name: Diamond Dust
70002937.description: A phenomenon that small ice grains are seen like shining due to light sources such as the sun. Since it takes place with close relationships with weather, temperature and wind direction, it's rare to be observed.

70002938.name: Frost Flower
70002938.description: It's formed when thin layers of ice are extruded from long-stemmed plants in autumn or early winter. The thin layers of ice are often formed into exquisite patterns that curl into 'petals' that resemble flowers.

70002939.name: Whirlpool
70002939.description: A body of swirling water produced by the meeting of opposing currents in particular straits. The ones that are maximum of 20m in diameter can also be seen. Since it cannot be observed in every sea, it seems to be affected by the topography in the ocean.

70002940.name: Hail
70002940.description: A phenomenon that small ice crystals fall from the sky. The crystal sizes vary between mm to cm. Its factor of occurrence is unknown; however, it generally occurs with lightning in a cloudy weather.

70002941.name: Aurora
70002941.description: A phenomenon where a band of light is found near the North Pole or the South Pole. The colors vary between light yellow to crimson red. From ancient times, the legend has floating light in the sky, and the phenomenon might have some relationship with it.

70002942.name: Light Pillar
70002942.description: A phenomenon in the form of a vertical light pillar which appears to extend above sea. Its factor of occurrence is unknown; however, when considering city lights or fishing boats are located in the direction of the pillar, those lights might be affecting it in some way.

70002943.name: Sun Pillar
70002943.description: A phenomenon somewhat like a light pillar showing above the sun during sunset and sunrise. The colors are observed similar as the sun's colors, orange and red.

70002944.name: Moon Pillar
70002944.description: A phenomenon somewhat like a light pillar showing near the moon during moonset and moonrise. Unlike the sun pillar, the shape of light looks close to an ellipse. It is often observed after the half moon when moonlight becomes brighter.

70002945.name: Tornado
70002945.description: A phenomenon that a gust of wind occurs spirally from the ground to the clouds in the sky. Sometimes, the gust becomes strong enough to destroy buildings; however, most of the time it's regional and the occurrence time is also quite short.

70002946.name: Waterspout
70002946.description: A tornado that occurs on the sea. It creates powerful gusts and irregular movements of water, and occasionally causes accidents such as ships getting swept away or sinking.

70002947.name: Aerial Tornado
70002947.description: A phenomenon in which the bottom of a tornado is in midair instead of touching the ground or sea. Due to this, damages do not occur on the ground or the sea. Conditions for this phenomenon to occur such as date and time seem similar to normal tornadoes.

70002948.name: Catatumbo Lightning
70002948.description: A very fierce windstorm mixed with thunderstorm which can be observed over and around Lake Maracaibo. It's so silent that the thunder from it cannot be heard. The light from the thunder is used as an alternative to a lighthouse by local ships.

70002949.name: Iridescent Cloud
70002949.description: The occurrence of colors in a cloud similar to those seen in oil films on puddles, located in the general vicinity of the sun or moon.

70002950.name: Fallstreak Hole
70002950.description: A thinly spread cloud with a circular gap in its center area. Occasionally, another cloud is formed directly below the open center.

70002951.name: Cumulonimbus Cloud
70002951.description: A large, dense, and vertical cloud. Violent storms and thunderstorms may occur under these heavy clouds. There are more sightings of this phenomenon during summer.

70002952.name: Geyser
70002952.description: A phenomenon in which steam and boiling water spurt out of the ground on a regular cycle. It's unknown what exactly happens within the ground, but because it emits hot water, it should be related to a volcanic activity.

70002954.name: Aurora Break-Up
70002954.description: A phenomenon where an aurora continuously changes colors and shapes while spreading out. This phenomenon lasts several minutes. Like auroras, the reason for this phenomenon is unknown.

70002955.name: Elephantnose Fish
70002955.description: A fish which inhabits places such as the Nile River. It features a protrusion on its head which resembles the trunk of an elephant. It is thought that the protrusion on its head is the result of evolution so that it can search for prey lying within the mud. As such, it's slower when securing food compared to other fishes.

70002956.name: Goblin Shark
70002956.description: A species of shark which has an appearance that can be compared to evil spirits. It can be distinguished by its long soft snout. When alive, its jaws are hidden inside the mouth but upon death, as time passes, those jaws become exposed.

70002957.name: Dumbo Octopus
70002957.description: An octopus with fins which resemble the shape of an ear. As it inhabits deeper seas as opposed to other octopi, perhaps these fins assists it with movement.

70002958.name: Boston
70002958.description: A harbor city located in the northeast part of the North American continent. It was a city landed and built by Pilgrims.

70002959.name: Omaha
70002959.description: A city located in the Midwest of the North American continent. After the Gold Rush, it was rapidly developed as the base of colony development and traffic of the east and the west.

70002960.name: Sacramento
70002960.description: A city located in the west part of the North American continent. Starting as a settlement of the colonists, it was remarkably developed as the base of colony development and trades, led by the Gold Rush.

70002961.name: Lake Huron
70002961.description: A lake located in the northeast part in the North American continent. It is a vast lake boasting its fourth largest surface area in the world.

70002962.name: Fossil of a Beast with a Bump
70002962.description: A fossil of a beast with a huge bump on the cranium. Reasons for the bump are unknown. Perhaps there were organs which existed outside of the bones.

70002963.name: Puskarini Pond
70002963.description: A pond in Lumbini which is said to be the birthplace of Buddha. It is said that Buddha after being born from his mother, had taken his first bath using water from this pond.

quests.name: The Land Where Buddha Was Born

70002964.name: Microlith
70002964.description: A type of chipped stone tool. Combined with a handle, it is treated as a tool with interchangeable ends. Widely excavated all around the world.

maps.name: Map of a Sharp Stone Tool

70002965.name: Shigir Idol
70002965.description: The oldest wooden sculpture in the world. Patterns engraved onto the statue's elongated figure resembles some sort of crypt, but it is difficult to understand its meaning.

70002966.name: Shakpak Ata
70002966.description: A mosque created by the Islamic missionary, Shakpak Ata. There seems to be multiple mosques similar to this one located within Ustyurt Plateau.

70002967.name: Statue of Himavat
70002967.description: A statue of Himavat, a deification of the Himalayas. The name originates from the meaning of 'freezing cold.'

70002968.name: Yeti's Scalp
70002968.description: The scalp of the mysterious humanoid being known as Yeti, locally enshrined. It is believed to be a servant of god according to the local lore. However, whether or not it really exists is unknown.

quests.name: Giant in the High Mountain Area

70002969.name: Money of Shamans
70002969.description: Money which sank to the bottom of the water near Shaman's Rock. The Shamans believed that the rock has the power to create miracles and threw money towards the area around the rock and performed some sort of ritual.

70002970.name: Large Plate of Kazan
70002970.description: A large golden plate. Kazan means large plate. According to lore, the land was called Kazan due to a princess of Tartar having dropped a large golden plate into the river.

70002971.name: Fossil of a Sea Creature
70002971.description: A fossil of a sea creature, discovered at Chomolungma. The reasons that many similar rocks have been found on top of the mountain is still unknown.

70002972.name: Shark Tooth Stone
70002972.description: A rock resembling a hardened shark tooth. Sometimes used for making amulets or accessories.

70002973.name: Frozen Lion
70002973.description: A frozen lion cub. Without reports of finding other lions of the same species within the area, it is unknown when this cub traveled to Siberia and fell into slumber.

70002974.name: Frozen Mammoth
70002974.description: A frozen elephant-like animal with large tusks. Although it is unknown when this animal fell into slumber, but its meat appears to have been stored in such a way that it appears to be fresh enough for consuming.

70002975.name: Shala Tree
70002975.description: A large tree with a trunk height of as high as 30 meters. It is said that Buddha had died in between two of these trees.

quests.name: Tree of the Far Away Hometown

70002976.name: Baikal Seal
70002976.description: Seals which inhabit Lake Baikal. A rare species which lives only in fresh water and is said to be at the top of the ecological system at Lake Baikal. They have large eyes used to search for prey.

70002977.name: Pamir Argali
70002977.description: A subspecies of Argali, or mountain sheep. They inhabit mountains and plateaus. As the first traveler that discovered this species was Marco Polo, they are also known as Marco Polo sheep.

70002978.name: Wild Yak
70002978.description: Cattle-like animals which inhabit highlands. Their entire body is covered with long hair. It is said that the hair of wild ones are black tea colored while tamed ones are red and white. They are used for multiple purposes such as carrying luggage and producing milk.

70002979.name: Caspian Tiger
70002979.description: A tiger which inhabits the highland east of the Caspian Sea. There are rumors that their bones have medicinal effect, but whether or not it is true is unknown.

70002980.name: Comephorus
70002980.description: Deep sea fish inhabiting Lake Baikal. These fish do not have scales or bladders, but it is capable of floating due to its abundant amount of fat.

70002981.name: Khumbu Icefall
70002981.description: A dangerous area where ice shards are scattered within the area. Travelers must pass through this area to reach the top of Chomolungma. There seems to be footprints which resemble human footprints within the area. Who or what do those footprints belong to?

70002982.name: Brahmaputra River
70002982.description: A river that flows around Himalaya. Its name means the son of Brahma. It connects with the Ganges river to form a large delta.

70002983.name: Rongbuk Glacier
70002983.description: A glacier flowing at the base of the Himalayas. By going up this glacier, you may be able to climb quite high up Chomolungma... Maybe...

70002984.name: Chomolungma
70002984.description: A large steep mountain which rejects all those who approach it. When will a mortal be able to reach the top?

quests.name: The Tallest Mountain In the World

70002985.name: Himalayas
70002985.description: Its name means inhabited by snow. It is one of the world's highest mountain ranges with a high peak and rich water resources. These mountains have obstructed the travels of people for many years. Without these mountain ranges, the history of the area would probably be greatly different from what it is now.

70002986.name: Kathmandu Valley
70002986.description: A valley within the Himalayas. Within the area exists three kingdoms which have developed some sort of complicated political situation with each other.

70002987.name: Shaman's Rock
70002987.description: A rock mountain worshipped by nearby shamans. It is said that you can prove your innocence by praying within that area for an entire day without being frozen to death.

70002988.name: Tuzbair Salt Lake
70002988.description: A salt lake in Ustyurt Plateau. Formed from rain and melting snow. If certain conditions are met, the surrounding mountains can be reflected on the surface of the water, creating a spectacular view.

quests.name: A Place Where Heaven and Earth Are Turned Upside Down
A Place Where Heaven and Earth Are Turned Upside Down

70002989.name: Arctic Tundra Region
70002989.description: A frozen region which never melts throughout the year. The area is not considered a wasteland as it is inhabited by reindeers and things such as moss and shrubs grow in the soil near the surface during the short summer experienced in the area.

70002990.name: Argo Navis
70002990.description: A constellation based off of the Argo's ship featured in Greek mythology. As it is quite large of a constellation, it is separated into multiple parts.

70002991.name: Thuban
70002991.description: One of the stars that make up the Draco constellation. It used to be considered a Polaris Star, but due to precession of the equinoxes, it is no longer a Polaris Star.

70002992.name: Black Tea Box
70002992.description: A box containing black tea which sank at the coast of Boston. Apparently, there was a quarrel between tea merchants and the residents.

70002993.name: Divrigi Great Mosque and Hospital
70002993.description: A building complex consisting of a mosque, a hospital, and a mausoleum. It is said that when the king at that time had ordered for the construction of the mosque, the wife had asked for a hospital to be built as well. The building features detailed patterns all over the doors, pillars, and walls. It is seen as having been built using the highest level of construction technology of the time.

70002994.name: Swayambhunath
70002994.description: An important Buddhism temple in Nepal. A pagoda stands at the center of the temple. On all four walls of the pagoda, is a painting of 'Buddha's eyes' which is said to see through everything.

70002995.name: Mani Stones
70002995.description: Stones with sutras and mantras carved in them. Can be found in regions with believers of Tibetan Buddhism. It is said that when walking pass these stones, it is better to walk with your right shoulder facing the stones.

maps.name: Map to a Stone with Carved Writings

70002996.name: Statue of Jabdar
70002996.description: Statue of a snake deity. One of the god of creations according to the lore of the Evenki people living in Siberia. It is said that a mammoth deity stacked rocks and created the continent while this god crawled around the continent and flattened it.

quests.name: Mythology of the Snake Deity of Creation

70002997.name: Beresta
70002997.description: An accessory case made in Russia. It's made with the skin of white birch. It is highly valued as a work of art due to its delicate decorations.

70002998.name: Petrified Forest
70002998.description: For whatever reason, the trees in the area have become like stone. Although there are no towering trees, it is an area that can only be described as a forest.

70002999.name: Manas
70002999.description: An epic that is passed down in the Kyrgyz region. It depicts the tales of the hero named Manas and his descendants. The reciter of the epic, the Manaschis, pass down the epic orally.

70003000.name: Dombra
70003000.description: A wooden string instrument often played in the Kazakhs region. A player plays it by plucking the two strings directly with their fingertips. Often played alone, or accompanying the singing of epics.

70003001.name: Yareta
70003001.description: A perennial plant which can be found at the highlands of the Andes mountains. Although each and one of them are quite small, as they grow together within the same area, they can sometimes be mistaken as one giant entity.

70003002.name: Turkey Vulture
70003002.description: Large bird inhabiting Central South America. As a bird species, it has a rare strong sense of smell, and is able to search for the corpses of its prey from afar.

maps.name: Map of a Bird with a Great Sense of Smell

70003003.name: Chaga Mushrooms
70003003.description: Mushroom that is sometimes known as the Siberian Lingzhi mushroom. It is said that brewing and drinking this mushroom helps cure diseases. It grows on birch trees but is quite rare.

70003004.name: Jackrabbit
70003004.description: A large rabbit with a body length exceeding 40cm that inhabits in North America. As its legs are quite developed, it is capable of running at speeds greater than 30km per hour.

70003005.name: Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake
70003005.description: A large poisonous snake inhabiting dry woodlands. It features diamond-shaped patterns and can reach a total length of 240cm.

70003006.name: Bozzhira
70003006.description: A strangely shaped rocky mountain located at the Ustyurt Plateau. Its name means 'white valley'. It features layers of white protected by lime as well as layers that are not.

70003007.name: Kvarken Archipelago
70003007.description: An archipelago located in the Baltic Sea. Due to the melting of glaciers that had once existed, the topography has changed and has risen in a complicated manner.

70003008.name: Custos Messium
70003008.description: A constellation modelled after the famous French astronomer, Charles Messier. It is not certain if it became well known in countries other than France...

70003009.name: North America Nebula
70003009.description: An emission nebula located at the tail of the Cygnus constellation. Its name comes from the way its shape resembles the North American continent, as it is dark, it is quite difficult to observe with the naked eye.

70003010.name: Mustang Caves
70003010.description: A group of mysterious caves dug in a certain cliff in Nepal. It may have once been a religious facility which contained Buddhist mural paintings. However, as there are many questions that have yet to be answered, it is difficult to conclude on the reason for these caves.

70003011.name: Al Khazneh
70003011.description: A royal tomb of the Petra ruins. Legend has it that thieves had hid their treasures inside, hence it is also called the 'The Treasury.'

quests.name: What You should be Searching for
What You should be Searching for

70003012.name: Blue Wolf Statue
70003012.description: A legendary beast which is considered to be the ancestor of Mongolians. According to 'The Secret History of the Mongols', it was also used as another name for Genghis Khan, while his wife was known as white doe.

70003013.name: Mani Wheel
70003013.description: A cylindrical Buddhist instrument. Mantras are engraved on the outside and the inside contains sutras. Often used for Tibetan Buddhism. It is said that the deed of spinning it once is equivalent to reading the sutras inside once.

70003014.name: Relic of the Tooth of the Buddha
70003014.description: A relic made of Buddha's tooth. Valued among Buddhist relics, especially the canine tooth as it is believed to hold great power.

70003015.name: Book of Exodus
70003015.description: The second book of the Old Testament. It focuses on the story of Moses and the Israelites escaping from Egypt.

70003017.name: Jami' al-tawarikh
70003017.description: A history book compiled under the orders of the king of Ilkhanate. Contains the history of the development of the Mongol empire as well as other ethnic groups. Its other name is the Compendium of Chronicles.

maps.name: Map to a Mongolia History Book

70003018.name: Glacier Chironomidae
70003018.description: A species of mosquito that inhabits the glacier at the Himalayas. As their wings have degenerated, they move with their feet.

70003019.name: Siberian Cat
70003019.description: A cat named after Siberia. Its round body is covered with long hair and as the name suggests, it is capable of adapting to the extreme cold temperatures of Siberia.

quests.name: Cats That Are Immune to Cold

70003020.name: Brain Coral
70003020.description: A type of coral. Its name comes from its hemispherical shape and its resemblance to the human brain.

70003021.name: Omul
70003021.description: A salmon-like fish inhabiting Lake Baikal. During spawning season, it swims up to the river to lay its eggs and returns to the lake afterwards. This fish is quite delicious when eaten.

maps.name: Map of a Fish Inhabiting a Lake

70003022.name: Death Zone
70003022.description: An altitude at which the air in the area becomes so thin that you are unable to breathe. On tall mountains such as Chomolungma, it can be life threatening. Those who climb this mountain and reach close to the summit are likely to collapse due to the thinness of the air.

70003023.name: Concretion
70003023.description: Large sphere-shaped rocks. It seems that various substances gathered around the corpse of a living organism to form such a shape. It is unknown as to why such a phenomenon occurs.

70003024.name: Dead Sea
70003024.description: A salt lake with high salt concentration. There is no flowing river as the water that flows in is less than the amount of water that evaporates. As such, the lake maintains its high salt concentration. As the environment makes it impossible for fish to inhabit, it is known as the lake of death.

70003025.name: Coalsack of the South
70003025.description: A dark nebula with the name of coalsack. It is seen near the Southern Cross. As it is in front of the Milky Way, it can sometimes be observed with the naked eye.

quests.name: Black Streaks Floating in the Sky
quests.location: Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea

70003026.name: Ara
70003026.description: A constellation shaped after an alter used to offer sacrifices to gods. According to Greek mythology, it is also said to be the altar where Zeus and his siblings swore to defeat their father, Chronos.

70003027.name: Redtail Catfish
70003027.description: A species of catfish spread around the Amazon River. It features a large mouth, six whiskers, and a body that can be greater than 1 meter. Its name is derived from its characteristics.

70003028.name: Senju Prawn
70003028.description: A small shrimp inhabiting the deep sea. Scissors are attached to all of its legs, its Japanese name means 'thousand-arms prawn' and is derived from the fact that all of its legs looks like its arms.

70003029.name: Japanese Deepwater Carrier Crab
70003029.description: A large crab inhabiting the deep sea. It is said that its back legs bend upward and carries things such as shells to protect itself.

70003031.name: Bird Sculpin
70003031.description: A species of rockfish inhabiting the waters of East Asia. It has large eyes, a head that is larger than its body, and a tail that is small and thin; its name originates from the resemblance of its face to a bird.

70003032.name: Gibberfishes
70003032.description: A deep-sea fish which appears to only inhabit near the equator. Although it does not feature many distinguishing characteristics, when it is young, it has a belly which is larger than its body. It has multiple organs on the tip of its fins, but for what purpose they exist is unknown.

70003033.name: Photonectes
70003033.description: A deep-sea fish characterized by its scaly body. It has a slender black body with a large upward facing mouth. It is said to emit light from its chin and the long beard growing from the tip of its lower jaw to lure out its prey.

70003034.name: Cappuccino Coast
70003034.description: A phenomenon in which things such as plankton in the sea are stirred by strong winds and waves, causing bubbles. This phenomenon can be seen all around the world, but it is very rare to see such a phenomenon happen in a large scale.

70003035.name: Volcanic Clastic Materials
70003035.description: A term for materials such as rock and mud that are expelled from volcanoes. After a volcano eruption, these materials may descend from the sky. Serious damage may be dealt to the surrounding areas if volcanic bombs were to be expelled from volcanoes.

70003036.name: Dirty Thunderstorm
70003036.description: Thunder caused by volcanic eruptions. As it is difficult to observe this phenomenon, a detailed cause of this phenomenon is still unknown. However, the existence of this phenomenon has been recorded in various documents of each country.

70003037.name: Sand Tornado
70003037.description: A tornado that occurs within desert areas. The color of these tornadoes appears to be different due to the sand gathered by the tornado. It is said that a large-scale sand tornado is capable of swallowing a small town.

70003038.name: St. Elmo's Fire
70003038.description: A phenomenon in which the tip of the mast of ships glow while sailing in bad weather. The name of this phenomenon varies depending on region and time. It has also been said that when two light phenomena occur at the same time, violent weather is soon to follow.

70003039.name: Red Sprite
70003039.description: A light phenomenon that occurs above thunder clouds. This name especially applies when the light that appears is red. As not many have been able to observe this phenomenon due to its occurrence location and duration, much is still unknown in regards to this phenomenon.

70003040.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
70003040.description: A strange light which appears in lakesides and graveyards during the night. There have been reports of this phenomenon where the color of the light spotted is either blue or green. Its name is derived from the saying of the wandering souls of those who have done many evil deeds.

70003041.name: Brocken Spectre
70003041.description: A phenomenon in which light such as from the sun shines from behind, creating a light ring resembling a rainbow. This phenomenon only occurs in open spaces that do not block daylight or fog. As such, it is more often seen at high altitudes such as on mountains.

70003042.name: Jacob's Ladder
70003042.description: A phenomenon where beams of sunlight can be seen from the gaps in clouds. Can often be observed in the early morning or evening when the sun goes down. It is said that the name of this phenomenon originates from the dream that Jacob from the Old Testament saw.

70003043.name: Mammatus Clouds
70003043.description: A phenomenon in which pouches of clouds can be seen hanging under the base of a cloud. It is thought to be created due to the movement of turbulence within or at the bottom of the cloud. As such, when observing this phenomenon, beware of heavy rainfall and storms.

70003044.name: Flying Dutchman
70003044.description: A ghost ship which is said to appear near the seas in the Cape of Good Hope. It is said that on a certain stormy day, the captain of the ship had cursed the wind and as a result, it now forever wanders in the sea.

70003045.name: Lenticular Cloud
70003045.description: A flat shaped cloud which appears in the sky above mountains and mountain ranges. As this phenomenon is known to occur more often in places with strong winds, it is known to be a sign of bad weather.

70003046.name: Ball Lightning
70003046.description: A phenomenon in which a light ball floats in the air. There have been reports of the phenomenon being various colours such as red, yellow and blue. Although this phenomenon is often seen during thunderstorms, there have also been reports of this phenomenon being seen in situations without wind and rain.

70003047.name: Red Rain in Kerala
70003047.description: The red rain which occurred in southern India. It has also been said that the rain may have been yellow or green. The cause of this phenomenon is unknown, and the effects of this rain on the human body is also unknown.

70003048.name: Red Snow
70003048.description: A phenomenon in which snow and ice appear to be red. There have been records of such a phenomenon since ancient times, but there has yet to be an accurate explanation to the cause of this phenomenon. One theory is that the phenomenon may related to oxides.

70003049.name: Antisolar Rays
70003049.description: A phenomenon that can be seen when the sun is near the horizon and hidden by clouds. Beams of light leaking from the cloud gathers on the opposite side of the sun.

70003050.name: Pangong Lake
70003050.description: A lake with a mix of sea water and fresh water located on the Central Eurasia Continent. It is known as the salt lake with the highest altitude in the world. During winter, ice as thick as 1 meter may be found spread across the lake.

70003051.name: Terma
70003051.description: Scriptures passed down from Tibetan Buddhism. They are sacred treasures hidden in various locations by Padmasambhava for future generations.

70003052.name: Snowball Plant
70003052.description: A perennial herbaceous plant inhabiting the alpines. The white hair growing from the leaf covers majority of the plant. It is said that the temperature inside of the plant covered by fur is higher, helping it grow in cold alpines.

70003053.name: Langtang
70003053.description: A valley located in the Himalayas. Rhodendrons grow there during spring. During summer, alpine plants bloom all around the valley; paired together with the surrounding mountains, it is considered to be a great scenic view.

70003054.name: Yellow Band
70003054.description: One of the three layers of Chomolungma. Multiple fossils have been found on this layer. By studying these fossils, you may be able to learn more about the environment in the past.

70003055.name: Imja Lake
70003055.description: A lake located at the base of Chomolungma. Formed by the gathering of water melted from the glacier. It is said that it would result in a disastrous situation if the dammed parts of the lake were to break down.

70003056.name: Olkon Island
70003056.description: The largest island floating in Lake Baikal. The east side of the island contains mountains while everywhere else on the island contains various terrains such as coniferous forests, prairies, small deserts and lakes. The island has been inhabited by Mongolian people since ancient times.

70003057.name: Old Ritualists' Book of Prayers
70003057.description: A book describing the Old Ritualist prayers of the Russian Orthodox Church. Those who follow teachings other than the main teachings focused on liturgy reformation are called Old Ritualists.

70003058.name: Angara River
70003058.description: The only river flowing out of Lake Baikal. The river flows north from the southwest end of the lake, merges with several rivers, flowing into the Arctic Ocean.

70003059.name: Komuz
70003059.description: Traditional string instrument from the Central Eurasia Continent. It is a beautiful instrument with a unique shape and detailed wood decorations.

70003060.name: Shopan Ata
70003060.description: An underground mosque located at Ustyurt Plateau. In the 12th century, one Islamic missionary was dispatched to the Central Eurasia Continent. It is said that his teacher had threw a staff and trees began growing from the staff. It is said that those trees still exist to this day.

70003061.name: Kara-Bogaz-Gol
70003061.description: The largest bay in the Caspian Sea. As water flowing in from the Caspian Sea does not flow out, the salt concentration of the bay is higher than the Caspian Sea. As such, fish that flow in from the Caspian Sea die shortly after.

70003062.name: Siberian Crane
70003062.description: A type of crane with a total length of approximately 1 meter. The tip of its wings are black. When it pauses and folds its wings, all black feathers are hidden and the whole body appears to look purely white.

70003063.name: Iceland Poppy
70003063.description: A poppy that is found across the Far East region of Siberia. It blooms white and yellow flowers. Very resistant to the cold weather, even strong enough to withstand the cold winters of Siberia. Like other poppies, it is toxic.

70003064.name: Karna's Earrings
70003064.description: Gold earrings worn by the Karna, the hero which appears in 'Mahabharata'. It is said that when worn with armor, one can gain the powers of immortality.

70003065.name: Iceman
70003065.description: A mummy discovered in the Alps. As it was frozen under snow, the mummy was very well preserved. At the time of discovery, several tools presumed belonging to the mummy was also discovered.

70003066.name: Nero's Grail
70003066.description: A well-made grail. It is said that the tyrant Nero often used it for poisoning others. Although it does not soak up poison, one would most likely still be hesitant in using the grail.

70003067.name: Gordias's Cart
70003067.description: The cart that was featured in Gordian Knot. The knot was prophesized as 'he who solves this will become the ruler of Asia'. What would Gordias think if he learned that the knot was unraveled by being cut with a sword?

70003068.name: Donation of Constantine
70003068.description: Imperial decree used for the basis of the formation of papacy. Although it has been said to be written by emperor Constantine, it has been suspected that it may be fake.

70003069.name: Kondoa Irangi Rock Paintings
70003069.description: Rock paintings that have been accumulated for thousands of years. There are paintings in red, black, and white. However, it would appear that paintings made in red are older than other paintings.

quests.name: Things You Can Learn from Rock Paintings

70003070.name: Dougga
70003070.description: Roman ruins from the Byzantine era in North Africa. Its name originates from the term 'thugga' which means to defend. There is evidence that it had once prospered as ruins of a temple, bathhouse, and a theatre was found.

70003071.name: Nihon Shoki
70003071.description: An ancient Japanese history book. It contains information from the formation of the country in the mythological era to the reign of the Emperor. One of the characteristics of the book is that it connects various hypotheses together.

70003072.name: Cleopatra's Pearls
70003072.description: Pearls worn as earrings by Cleopatra. At the time, it was said to be the largest in the world. It has been said one of the pearls were dissolved in vinegar and drank, but to dissolve something this large would probably be quite difficult.

70003073.name: Baalbek
70003073.description: Ruins composed of three temples enshrining three gods of Rome. The name of these ruins originate from the God of Phoenicia. It's almost as if you're witnessing the change in times.

70003074.name: Gifts from the Three Wise Men
70003074.description: Gifts brought by three wise men to celebrate the birth of Jesus. The gifts were gold, frankincense and myrrh, which represented the kingship, divinity, and passion of Jesus.

70003075.name: Tablet of Destinies
70003075.description: A tablet once possessed by Nabu, the god off literacy, the rational arts, scribes and wisdom according to Mesopotamian mythology. It is believed that the fate of mankind is carved on this tablet. Although it's quite small, it's probably not something humans can comprehend.

70003076.name: The Iron Crown of Lombardy
70003076.description: An iron crown said to have been made from a nail used in the crucifixion of Jesus. For that reason, it is known as an iron crown and is considered a holy relic.

70003077.name: Saint Euphemia's Coffin
70003077.description: A coffin in which the body of Saint Euphemia was placed in. Although she was subjected to various torture, she did not lose faith and continued to pray to God for the suffering and martyrdom.

70003078.name: Harp of Bragi
70003078.description: A golden harp played by Bragi, the god of poetry in Norse mythology. It is said that its sounds resonate from the heavens to the netherworld; adored by the trees and the rivers.

quests.name: God of Art in Norse Mythology

70003079.name: Coffin of Osiris
70003079.description: The coffin used when Osiris was murdered. It was swept by the rivers, wrapped by trees, and used as a pillar with the corpse inside all messed up. It's rare for a coffin to have such a long lifespan.

70003080.name: Treasure of Fafnir
70003080.description: Treasure of unknown origin. It is unknown who left it there or when it was placed there. There are rumours of the treasure being the cursed treasure guarded by Fafnir. As such, even bandits hesitate in taking the treasure.

70003081.name: Statue of Pope Joan
70003081.description: A statue of Pope Joan. However, as there is no hard evidence of the existence of Pope Joan, it is unknown whether this statue was truly modeled after her.

70003082.name: Kurukshetra Plains
70003082.description: In the story of 'Mahabharata', this location was used as the location of the final battle. To Bharata people, it is considered a sacred location.

70003083.name: Mount Semeru
70003083.description: The highest peak among the islands in the eastern part of Java. As it is one of the most active volcanoes, many eruptions occur. Its name comes from Mount Mera, which according to ancient India, is considered to be the center of all universes.

quests.name: Mountain in the Center of the World

70003084.name: Aeolian Islands
70003084.description: Islands located north of Sicily; an archipelago made from volcanic activity, of which Stromboli has been erupting more actively.

70003085.name: Ha Long Bay
70003085.description: A large bay with numerous small islands, and a beautiful landscape. Its name is derived from the meaning of descending dragon.

70003086.name: Salamis Island
70003086.description: One of the islands located in the Aegean Sea. The island was used as a gathering place for the Greek fleet during the Battle of Salamis.

70003087.name: Waiben Island
70003087.description: An island located in the Arafura Sea, north of Australia. Many pearl oysters inhabit the surrounding seas.

70003088.name: James Bay
70003088.description: A bay located north of North America, in the southern parts of the Hudson Bay. During spring, it is closed off due to drifting ice made in winter and many birds migrate over to the developed tidal flats.

70003089.name: Mcdonald Islands
70003089.description: Islands located southwest of Australia. They're small islands composed of rocks; inhabited by seals and sea lions.

70003090.name: Kimolos
70003090.description: A Greek island in the Aegean Sea. At the South coast, there's a silver rock area which was apparently used as a place of trading. Due to echidnas inhabiting the island and being commonly found there, the island also has another name of Echnousa.

70003091.name: Aramu Muru's Gate of the Gods
70003091.description: Ruins located near Lake Titicaca. There's a hallow area which resembles a doorway. It is said that the ancient king Aramu Muru passed through this area and disappeared, never to return again.

70003092.name: Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor
70003092.description: A giant mausoleum. As burial goods, statues of soldiers and horses known as the Teracotta Army are also buried within the mausoleum. As it is built on such a large scale, there has yet to be anyone who has a full understanding and grasp in regards to the mausoleum.

70003093.name: Bone Chapel
70003093.description: A chapel built at the cathedral. Its interior is decorated with thousands of skulls gathered from the graveyards of surrounding Catholic religious orders.

70003094.name: Mausoleum of Khoja Ahmed Yasawi
70003094.description: A mausoleum containing the grave of an Islamic Saint from the 12th century, Ahmed Yasawi. As the person who was building the mausoleum had passed away before its completion, the mausoleum remains incomplete.

70003095.name: Claddagh Ring
